1""" 

2This file implements the algorithm to determine continuum channel ranges to  

3use from an ALMA image cube (dirty or clean) in CASA format. All dependencies  

4on what were originally analysisUtils functions have been pasted into this  

5file for convenience. This function is meant to be run inside CASA.  

6Simple usage: 

7 import findContinuum as fc 

8 fc.findContinuum('my_dirty_cube.image') 

9This file can be found in a typical pipeline distribution directory, e.g.: 

10/lustre/naasc/sciops/comm/rindebet/pipeline/branches/trunk/pipeline/extern 

11As of March 7, 2019 (version 3.36), it is compatible with both python 2 and 3.

343def casalogPost(mystring, debug=True, priority='INFO'): 

344 """ 

345 Generates an INFO message prepended with the version number of findContinuum. 

346 """ 

347 if (debug): print(mystring) 

348 token = version(False).split() 

349 origin = token[1].replace(',','_') + token[2] 

350 casalog.post(mystring.replace('\n',''), origin=origin, priority=priority)

368def help(match='', debug=False): 

369 """ 

370 Print an alphabetized list of all the defined functions at the top level in 

371 this python file. 

372 match: limit the list to those functions containing this string (case insensitive) 

373 -- Todd Hunter 

374 """ 

375 myfile = __file__ 

376 if (myfile[-1] == 'c'): 

377 if (debug): print("au loaded from .pyc file, looking at .py file instead") 

378 myfile = myfile[:-1] 

379 aufile = open(myfile,'r') 

380 lines = aufile.readlines() 

381 if (debug): print("Read %d lines from %s" % (len(lines), __file__)) 

382 aufile.close() 

383 commands = [] 

384 for line in lines: 

385 if (line.find('def ') == 0): 

386 commandline = line.split('def ')[1] 

387 tokens = commandline.split('(') 

388 if (len(tokens) > 1): 

389 command = tokens[0] 

390 else: 

391 command = commandline.strip('\n\r').strip('\r\n') 

392 if (match == '' or command.lower().find(match.lower()) >= 0): 

393 commands.append(command) 

394 commands.sort() 

395 for command in commands: 

396 print(command)

398def round_half_up(x): 

399 return float(decimal.Decimal(float(x)).to_integral_value(rounding=decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP))

401def is_binary(filename): 

402 """ 

403 This function is called by runFindContinuum. 

404 Return true if the given filename appears to be binary. 

405 Works in python 2.7 and 3 

406 """ 

407 f = os.popen('file %s'%filename, 'r') 

408 result = f.read().find('text') 

409 f.close() # fix for PL2026 

410 if result == -1: 

411 return True 

412 else: 

413 return False 

414 

415# Old method: fails in python 3 

416# File is considered to be binary if it contains a NULL byte. 

417# This approach returns True for .fits files, but 

418# incorrectly reports UTF-16 as binary. 

419# with open(filename, 'rb') as f: 

420# for block in f: 

421# if '\0' in block: 

422# return True

425def getMemorySize(): 

426 """ 

427 This function is called by findContinuum and runFindContinuum. 

428 """ 

429 try: 

430 return(os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE') * os.sysconf('SC_PHYS_PAGES')) 

431 except ValueError: 

432 # SC_PHYS_PAGES can be missing on OS X 

433 return int(subprocess.check_output(['sysctl', '-n', 'hw.memsize']).strip())

487 skipAmendMask=False, useAnnulus=True, cubeSigmaThreshold=7.5, 

488 npixThreshold=7, nbin=1, useJointMaskPrior=False, telescope='ALMA', 

489 window='flat', subimage=False, maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustment=1.18, # 104 

490 maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustmentInLaterIterations=1.18, 

491 sigmaFindContinuumForExtraMask=2.5, momDiffLevel=8.0, 

492 peakOverMadCriterion=65, momDiffLevelForProceeding=8.0, # 109 

493 minGroupsForSFCAdjustment=7, maxGroups=15, momDiffApproachLevel=15.0, 

494 mom08simultaneous=True, useUncorrectedMedian=False, storeExtraMask=False, 

495 returnBluePoints=False, removeOutlierBaselineChannels='', 

496 enableInitialQuadratic=True, skipCubeNoise=False, 

497 returnMomDiffSNR=False, spectralDynamicRangeBandWidth=None, 

498 tooManyPixels=850, useBaseline='auto'): # 123 

499 """ 

500 This function calls functions to: 

501 1) compute a representative 'mean' spectrum of a dirty cube 

502 2) find the continuum channels  

503 3) plot the results and writes a text file with channel ranges and frequency ranges 

504 It calls runFindContinuum up to 2 times.  

505 If meanSpectrumMethod != 'mom0mom8jointMask', then it runs it a second  

506 time with a reduced field size if it finds only one range of continuum  

507 channels.  

508 

509 Please note that the channel ranges do not necessarily map back to  

510 the visibility spectra in the measurement set(s). In order to produce  

511 channel ranges that are guaranteed to map back correctly, then you must  

512 supply a list of all desired measurement sets to the vis parameter. In  

513 this case, the final line in the .dat file created will contain the  

514 channel list in the correct frequency frame and order. 

515 

516 Returns: 

517 -------- 

518 * A channel selection string suitable for the spw parameter of clean. 

519 * The name of the final png produced. 

520 * The aggregate bandwidth in continuum in GHz. 

521 If returnAllContinuumBoolean = True, then it also returns a Boolean desribing 

522 if it thinks the whole spectrum is continuum (True) or not (False) 

523 Cycle 7 pipeline usage should set returnAllContinuumBoolean = True 

524 If returnWarnings = True, then it also returns a list of warning strings, 

525 which may be empty [], for tooLittleBandwidth and/or tooLittleSpread (PL2020+) 

526 and the name of the joint mask image (PL2022+) 

527 If returnSnrs = True, then it also returns two more lists: mom0snrs and mom8snrs, 

528 and the max baseline (floating point meters) inferred from the psf image 

529 if returnSigmaFindContinuum = True (new in PL2020), then it also returns 17 more things: 

530 1) the final value used for sigmaFindContinuum (PL2022: at the end of the .original stage) 

531 2) the Boolean intersectionOfSelections  

532 3) number of central ranges that were (or would have been) dropped, summed 

533 over all runs of findContinuumChannels by the final run of runFindContinuum. 

534 4) the result of amendMaskYesOrNo (if it was run; False otherwise) 

535 5) the result of extraMaskYesOrNo (if it was run; False otherwise) 

536 6) the result of extraMaskYesOrNo test 2 (if it was run; False otherwise) 

537 7) the result of autoLower 

538 8) the name of the finalMomDiff image (if amendMask=True) else the final mom8fc image 

539 9) the logic path code (for amendMask) (pathCode) 

540 10) the 4-letter code (for amendMask) (momDiffCode) 

541 11) the SNR in the final momDiff image (momDiffSNR) 

542 12) name of meanSpectrumFile produced 

543 13) name of the "_findContinuum.dat" file produced 

544 14) positiveThreshold (upper black dotted line) 

545 15) negativeThreshold (lower black dotted line) 

546 16) median (solid black line) 

547 17) median of selected continuum channels (dotted cyan line) 

548 If returnMomDiffSNR = True (new in PL2023) and returnSigmaFindContinuum & returnSNRs=False 

549 then also return the momDiffSNR value. 

550 PL2023 use case (returnWarnings=True, returnAllContinuumBoolean=True returnMomDiffSNR=False)  

551 will return:  

552 selection, png, aggregateBandwidth, allContinuum, warningStrings, jointMask 

553 

554 Required Inputs: 

555 ---------------- 

556 img: the image cube to operate upon (as opposed to specifying a 

557 pre-existing meanSpectrumFile from a previous run) 

558 --or-- 

559 meanSpectrumFile: an alternative pre-existing ASCII text file to use 

560 for the mean spectrum, instead of operating on the img to create one.  

561 Note: if you specify meanSpectrumFile and vis, you must also specify img, but 

562 only its metadata will be used. 

563 Parameters relevant only to meanSpectrumFile: 

564 * invert: if True, then invert the sign of intensity and add the minimum 

565 

566 Optional inputs (see also General Parameters below): 

567 --------------------------------------------------- 

568 spw: the spw name or number (integer or string integer) to put in the x-axis label; 

569 also, it will be used to select the spw for which to generate topo channels for the  

570 *.dat file if vis is also specified; if vis is specified and spw is  

571 not, then it will search the name of the image for an spw number  

572 and use it for generating the topo channel list. 

573 transition: the name of the spectral transition (for the plot title) 

574 avoidance: a CASA channel selection string to avoid selecting (for manual use); 

575 invoked at the end of each execution of runFindContinuum() 

576 meanSpectrumMethod: 'auto', 'mom0mom8jointMask', 'peakOverMad', 'peakOverRms',  

577 'meanAboveThreshold', 'meanAboveThresholdOverRms', 'meanAboveThresholdOverMad',  

578 where 'peak' refers to the peak in a spatially-smoothed version of cube 

579 'auto' invokes 'meanAboveThreshold' unless sky temperature range  

580 (max-min) from the atmospheric model is more than skyTempThreshold  

581 in which case it invokes 'peakOverMad' instead 

582 ALMA Cycle 5 used 'auto', while ALMA Cycle 6 will use 'mom0mom8jointMask' 

583 

584 Parameters relevant only to 'mom0mom8jointMask' (i.e., ALMA Cycle 6 onward) 

585 --------------------------------------------------------------------- 

586 * nbin: if greater than NBIN_THRESHOLD (4), then smooth spectrum by this 

587 many channels 

588 * spectralDynamicRangeBandWidth: frequency string with units;  

589 compute nbin based on this value (overrides nbin parameter),  

590 example: '5.1MHz' 

591 * window: the smoothing window to use with nbin (one of: 'gauss', 

592 'flat','hanning','hamming','bartlett','blackman') 

593 * minPeakOverMadForSFCAdjustment: scalar value 

594 * pbcube: the primary beam response for img, but only used by  

595 meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask'. If not specified,  

596 it will be searched for by changing file suffix from .residual to .pb 

597 * psfcube: the psf response for img, but only used by  

598 meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask'. If not specified,  

599 it will be searched for by changing file suffix from .residual to .psf, 

600 if still not found, then pruneMask will default to 6 pixels 

601 * minbeamfrac: only used if psfcube is specified and meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask' 

602 floating point value or 'auto' for 0.3 for 12m and 0.1 for 7m (maxBaseline<60m) 

603 Set to zero to prevent pruning of the joint mask entirely; otherwise pruneMask 

604 will use np.max([4,minbeamfrac*pixelsPerBeam]) 

605 * minPixelsInJointMask: if fewer than these pixels are found (after pruning), then 

606 use all pixels above pb=0.3 (or equivalent higher value on mitigated images). 

607 This option was essentially obseleted by the addition of pruneMask with the 

608 knowledge of beamsize from psfcube. To avoid having any effect, it should be set  

609 to < minbeamfrac*minPixelsPerBeam, which is typically 0.5*7=3.5; so use 3 or less. 

610 * userJointMask: if specified, use this joint mask instead of computing one 

611 (this option is meant for test purposes only, typically *.mask2_bi) 

612 * useJointMaskPrior: if True, and if the <img>_mom0mom8jointMaskPrior.pkl file exists, 

613 then it will skip the creation of joint.mask and joint.mask2 on the first  

614 iteration of amendMask to save some time.  

615 * normalizeByMAD: can be True, False or 'auto' (default);  

616 if 'auto', then if atmospheric transmission varies enough across the spw,  

617 set to True, otherwise set to False.  

618 If True, then request normalization of the resulting mean spectrum by the  

619 xmadm spectrum using an outer annulus and outside the joint mask. The  

620 nominal annulus is the 0.2-0.3 pb response, but the range will  

621 automatically be scaled upward with minimum value in the pb cube,  

622 in order to preserve the fractional number of pixels contained in  

623 a single field's 0.2-0.3 annulus.  

624 * mom0minsnr: sets the threshold for the mom0 image (i.e. median + mom0minsnr*scaledMAD) 

625 * mom8minsnr: sets the threshold for the mom8 image (i.e. median + mom8minsnr*scaledMAD) 

626 * snrThreshold: if SNR is higher than this, then run a phase 2 mask calculation 

627 * bidirectionalMaskPhase2: True=extend mask to negative values beyond threshold;  

628 False=Cycle6+ behavior (True was tried but gives worse results in some cases) 

629 * enableInitialQuadratic: if True, assess the need for quadratic removal, and use  

630 the old-style method to remove it; if 'auto', then set to True only 

631 if the lowercase version of the source name includes venus, mars, 

632 jupiter, saturn, uranus, or neptune 

633 * rmStatContQuadratic: if True, then do not do the initialQuadratic removal (if  

634 enabled and deemed necessary), but instead always perform the new-style  

635 quadratic removal 

636 * makeMovie: if True, then make a png for each quadratic fit as channels are  

637 removed one-by-one (in the rmStatContQuadratic option) 

638 * quadraticNsigma: the stopping threshold to use when ignoring outliers prior to  

639 fitting the quadratic (in the rmStatContQuadratic option). To more quickly test  

640 different values, be sure to set the meanSpectrumFile option and overwrite=False) 

641 * allowBluePruning: use continuum range pruning heuristic added in Cycle 6 (default=True) 

642 * amendMaskIterations (new in PL2020): if 'auto', then choose 0 for TDM and 3 for FDM; 

643 if 0, then do not attempt any amendMask (i.e. mimic the Cycle 7 pipeline release) 

644 if >=1, then when finished the initial findContinuum trial, create a mom8fc image and 

645 mom0fc image scaled by nchan and chanwidth in kms, and subtract them to create momDiff  

646 image. If the momDiff image has sufficient signal remaining in it, then expand the 

647 joint mask, and repeat the findContinuum process with this expanded mask as the 

648 userJointMask; if >=2, and there is still sufficient signal in the new momDiff image from 

649 the second run of findContinuum, then check if further analysis of the extra portion of the  

650 mask is necessary. If so, first check if intersecting the ranges of the first two rounds 

651 eliminates the excess, otherwise create a new spectrum from it and pass it into a third 

652 round of findContinuum with this as the meanSpectrum file. If >=3, and there is stil 

653 sufficient signal in the new momDiff, image then set sigmaFindContinuumMode='autolower' 

654 and sigmaFindContinuum=most recent value, and run another round of findContinuum. 

655 If >= 4, and and there is sufficient signal in the new momDiff, run another round 

656 of autolower. 

657 * skipAmendMask: if True, then skip the test for amend mask, and move on to onlyExtraMask 

658 * skipCubeNoise: if True, then do not run cubeNoiseLevel, instead set MADCubeOutside to 

659 DISABLE_CUBE_NOISE and the cubeMedian to zero 

660 * tooManyPixels: value of pixels in mask beyond which amendMask will not  

661 proceed, and causes result code 'P#' 

662 * storeExtraMask: if True, the write the extraMask as a mask image (for debugging) 

663 * momDiffLevel: if amendMaskIterations>0, sets the level above which pixels are counted. 

664 For SingleContinuum 7m spws, the value is automatically incremented by 3.5. It is not 

665 recommended to change this parameter, as it affects many heuristics. Change the next one. 

666 * momDiffLevelForProceeding: if amendMaskIterations>0, sets the level above pixels must be 

667 in the mom8-mom0 image difference to be counted when determining whether to amend the mask. 

668 * useAnnulus: if amendMaskIterations>0, sets whether median/MAD in imageSNR be assessed in  

669 annulus but outside the jointmask (True) or simply outside the joint mask (False) 

670 * subimage: if True, then add 0.2 to both radii of the annulus 

671 * enableOnlyExtraMask: if False, then do not do the extraMask or onlyExtraMask iterations 

672 * useMomentDiff: if False, use the mom8fc image to assess AmendMask decision instead of momDiff 

673 * checkIfMaskWouldHaveBeenAmended (new in PL2020): if True, then if amendMaskIterations=0,  

674 then it will still check to see if the mask would have been amended and return the  

675 result (assuming that returnSigmaFindContinuum==True) -- for test purposes only 

676 * maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustment: one of the controls for lowering sigmaFindContinuum in 

677 the .original amendMask iteration  

678 * maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustmentInLaterIterations: one of the controls for lowering  

679 sigmaFindContinuum in amendMask iterations after the .original iteration 

680  

681 Parameters relevant only to 'peakOverMad' or 'mom0mom8jointMask': 

682 ----------------------------------------------------------- 

683 * maxGroups: maximum number of continuum regions below which the potential reduction  

684 factor of sigmaFindContinuum will be scaled by (1 - groups/maxGroups)**(bandwidth/1875e6) 

685 via the following equation: 

686 sFC_factor = np.max([scalingFactor/7.0, (1-groups/float(maxGroups)) ** (spwBandwidth/1.875e9)]) 

687 

688 Parameters relevant only to meanSpectrumMethod='auto' and 'mom0mom8jointMask': 

689 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 

690 * skyTempThreshold: rms value in Kelvin (for FDM spectra<1000MHz), above which  

691 the meanSpectrumMethod is changed in 'auto' mode to peakOverMad; and above 

692 which normalizeByMAD is set True in meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask' 

693 when normalizeByMAD='auto' mode 

694 * tdmSkyTempThreshold: rms value in Kelvin (for TDM and 1875MHz FDM spectra)  

695 * skyTransmissionThreshold: threshold on (max-min)/mean, above which the 

696 meanSpectrumMethod is changed in 'auto' mode to peakOverMad; and above 

697 which normalizeByMAD is set True in meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask' 

698 when normalizeByMAD='auto' mode 

699 * overwriteMoments: if True, then overwrite any existing moment0 or moment8 image  

700 * overwriteMasks: if True, then overwrite any existing moment0 or moment8 mask image  

701 * rmStatContQuadratic: if True, then fit and remove quadratic after removing outliers 

702 * outdir: directory to write the .mom0 and .mom8 images, .png, .dat and meanSpectrum 

703 (default is same directory as the cube) 

704 * avoidExtremaInNoiseCalcForJointMask (new in PL2020): experimental Boolean to avoid  

705 pixels <5%ile and >95%ile in the chauvenet imstat of mom0 and mom8 images 

706 

707 Parameters relevant only to 'auto': 

708 ----------------------------------- 

709 * triangleFraction: remove a triangle shape if the MAD of the dual-linfit residual  

710 is less than this fraction*originalMAD; set this parameter to zero to turn it off. 

711 

712 Parameters relevant only to 'peakOverMad' or 'meanAboveThreshold*': 

713 ------------------------------------------------------------------- 

714 * maxMemory: behave as if the machine has this many GB of memory 

715 * nanBufferChannels: when removing or replacing NaNs, do this many extra channels 

716 beyond their extent 

717 * channelFractionForSlopeRemoval: if this many channels are initially selected,  

718 then fit and remove a linear slope and re-identify continuum channels 

719 Set to 1 to turn off. 

720 * quadraticFit: if True, fit quadratic polynomial to the noise regions when  

721 deemed appropriate; Otherwise, fit only a linear slope 

722 * centralArcsec: radius of central box within which to compute the mean spectrum 

723 default='auto' means start with whole field, then reduce to 1/10 if only 

724 one window is found (unless mask is specified); or 'fwhm' for the central square 

725 with the same radius as the PB FWHM; or a floating point value in arcseconds 

726 * mask: a mask image preferably equal in shape to the parent image that is used to determine 

727 the region to compute the noise (outside the mask, i.e. mask=0) and  

728 (in the 'meanAboveThresholdMethod') the mean spectrum (inside the mask, i.e. mask=1).  

729 The spatial union of all masked pixels in all channels is used as the mask for each channel. 

730 Option 'auto' will look for the <filename>.mask that matches the <filename>.image 

731 and if it finds it, it will use it; otherwise it will use no mask. 

732 If the mask does not match in shape but is multi-channel, it will be regridded to match 

733 and written out as <filename>.mask.regrid. 

734 If it matches spatially but is single-channel, this channel will be used for all. 

735 To convert a .crtf file to a mask, use: 

736 makemask(mode='copy', inpimage=img, inpmask='chariklo.crtf', output=img+'.mask') 

737 * applyMaskToMask: if True, apply the mask inside the user mask image to set its masked pixels to 0 

738 

739 Parameters relevant only to 'peakOverRms' and 'peakOverMad': 

740 ------------------------------------------------------------ 

741 * peakFilterFWHM: value (in pixels) to presmooth each plane with a Gaussian kernel of 

742 this width. Set to 1 to not do any smoothing. 

743 Default = 10 which is typically about 2 synthesized beams. 

744 

745 Parameters relevant only to 'meanAboveThreshold': 

746 ------------------------------------------------- 

747 * useAbsoluteValue: passed to meanSpectrum, then avgOverCube -- take absolute value of 

748 the cube before producing mean spectrum 

749 * useThresholdWithMask: if False, then just take mean rather than meanAboveThreshold 

750 when a mask has been specified 

751 * useIAGetProfile: if True, then for baselineMode='min', use ia.getprofile instead of  

752 ia.getregion and subsequent arithmetic (faster, less memory exhaustive) 

753 * continuumThreshold: if specified, begin by using only pixels above this intensity level 

754 * sigmaCube: multiply this value by the MAD to get the threshold above  

755 which a voxel is included in the mean spectrum. 

756 * baselineModeA: 'min' or 'edge', method to define the baseline in meanSpectrum() 

757 Parameters relevant to 'min': 

758 ----------------------------- 

759 * percentile: control parameter for 'min' 

760 

761 Parameters relevant to 'edge': 

762 * nBaselineChannels: if integer, then the number of channels to use in: 

763 a) computing the mean spectrum with the 'meanAboveThreshold' methods. 

764 b) computing the MAD of the lowest/highest channels in findContinuumChannels 

765 if float, then the fraction of channels to use (i.e. the percentile) 

766 default = 0.19, which is 24 channels (i.e. 12 on each side) of a TDM window 

767 

768 Parameters relevant only when amendMaskIterations > 0 (new for PL2020) 

769 ---------------------------------------------------------------------- 

770 * keepIntermediatePngs: if True, keep changing the png name to avoid overwriting them; only 

771 the final one is returned 

772 * thresholdForSame: fractional value used to determine if the residual in the mom8fc image 

773 improved ('L'), worsened ('H') or stayed the same ('S') 

774 * cubeSigmaThreshold: minimum cube SNR for onlyExtraMask to trigger 

775 * npixThreshold: minimum momDiff pixels for onlyExtraMask to trigger 

776 

777 Parameters for function findContinuumChannels (which is called by all meanSpectrum heuristics): 

778 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

779 baselineModeB: 'min' (default) or 'edge', method to define the baseline  

780 Parameters only relevant if baselineModeB='min': 

781 * dropBaselineChannels: percentage of extreme values to drop 

782 * removeOutlierBaselineChannels: after dropBaselineChannels, remove >4*scMAD  

783 outliers; options: 'high', 'low', 'both', or '' == none/False 

784 useBaseline: 'low', 'middle', 'high' or 'auto'; auto tries to automatically pick 'low' for 

785 spectra that are emission-line dominated, 'high' if absorption line dominated, or 'both' if 

786 both types of lines are present 

787 nBaselineChannels: if integer, then the number of channels to use in computing 

788 standard deviation/MAD of the baseline channels (i.e. the blue points in the plot) 

789 if float, then it is the fraction of channels to use (i.e. the percentile) 

790 sigmaFindContinuum: starting value for sigmaFindContinuum; passed to findContinuumChannels,  

791 'auto' starts with value: 

792 TDM: singleContinuum: 9, meanAboveThreshold: 4.5, peakOverMAD: 6.5, 

793 mom0mom8jointMask: 7.2 

794 FDM: meanAboveThreshold: 3.5, peakOverMAD: 6.0,  

795 mom0mom8jointMask: nchan<750: 4.2 (strong lines) or 4.5 (weak lines)  

796 nchan>=759: 2.5 (strong lines) or 3.2 (weak lines) 

797 and adjusts it depending on results 

798 sigmaFindContinuumMode (new in PL2020): 'auto', 'autolower', 'fixed' 

799 trimChannels: after doing best job of finding continuum, remove this many  

800 channels from each edge of each block of channels found (for margin of safety) 

801 If it is a float between 0..1, then trim this fraction of channels in each  

802 group (rounding up). If it is 'auto' (default), use 0.1 but not more than  

803 maxTrim channels, and not more than maxTrimFraction 

804 narrow: the minimum number of channels that a group of channels must have to survive 

805 if 0<narrow<1, then it is interpreted as the fraction of all 

806 channels within identified blocks 

807 if 'auto', then use int(ceil(log10(nchan))) 

808 maxTrim: in trimChannels='auto', this is the max channels to trim per group for  

809 TDM spws; it is automatically scaled upward for FDM spws. 

810 maxTrimFraction: in trimChannels='auto', the max fraction of channels to trim per group 

811 singleContinuum: if True, treat the cube as having come from a Single_Continuum setup; 

812 For testing purpose, if None, then check the contents of vis (if specified). 

813 negativeThresholdFactor: scale the nominal negative threshold by this factor (to  

814 adjust the sensitivity to absorption features: smaller values=more sensitive) 

815 signalRatioTier1: threshold for signalRatio, above which we desensitize the level to 

816 consider line emission in order to avoid small differences in noise levels from  

817 affecting the result (e.g. that occur between serial and parallel tclean cubes) 

818 signalRatio=1 means: no lines seen, while closer to zero: more lines seen 

819 enableRejectNarrowInnerWindows (new in PL2020): if True, then remove any inner groups  

820 of channels that are narrower than both edge windows (when there are 3-15 groups) 

821 

822 General parameters: 

823 ------------------- 

824 verbose: if True, then print additional information during processing 

825 useUncorrectedMedian: if True, then do not adjust the median (solid black line) upward 

826 from the median of the baseline points (dashed blue line) 

827 returnBluePoints: if True, then simply set the continuum ranges to the baseline points  

828 (i.e. the blue points) inside each run of findContinuumChannels(). If using 

829 mom0mom8jointMask with amendMask option, then also stop after amendMask (and 

830 automatically disable the onlyExtraMask step, even if enableOnlyExtraMask=True) 

831 momentdir (new in PL2020): alternative directory to look for (and write) the  

832 moment 0&8 images 

833 png: the name of the png to produce ('' yields default name) 

834 pngBasename: if True, then remove the directory from img name before generating png name 

835 source: the name of the source, to be shown in the title of the spectrum. 

836 if None, then use imhead('object') 

837 overwrite: if True, or ASCII file does not exist, then recalculate the mean spectrum 

838 writing it to <img>.meanSpectrum 

839 if False, then read the mean spectrum from the existing ASCII file 

840 separator: the character to use to separate groups of channels in the string returned 

841 titleText: default is img name and transition and the control parameter values 

842 plotAtmosphere: '', 'tsky', or 'transmission' 

843 airmass: for plot of atmospheric transmission 

844 skipchan (newly-exposed in PL2020): used in making the spectral plot, the number of highest  

845 and lowest intensity channels to avoid when constructing the y-axis range 

846 pwv: in mm (for plot of atmospheric transmission) 

847 vis: comma-delimited list or python list of measurement sets to use to convert channel 

848 ranges to topocentric frequency ranges (for use in uvcontfit or uvcontsub) 

849 or 'auto' which will look for any/all vis in the cube directory 

850 plotBaselinePoints: if True, then plot the baseline-defining points as black dots 

851 fontsize (newly-exposed in PL2020): size to use for channel ranges, axis labels and plot legend 

852 dpi: dots per inch to use in writing the png (106 produces 861x649 pixels) 

853 150 produces 1218x918 

854 projectCode: a string to prepend to the title of the plot (useful for regression testing 

855 where you can put the page number from the full PDF when running only a subset) 

856 buildMom8fc (new in PL2020): if True, then when finished, generate "mom8fc" and "mom0fc" 

857 images using selected channels 

858 smallBandwidthFraction: threshold for returning a warning for too little bandwidth found 

859 smallSpreadFraction: threshold for returning a warning for too little bandwidth spread found 

860 telescope: name of telescope to use (if no image is passed from which to  

861 read it from the header) 

862 window: the smoothing window to apply to the mean spectrum (when nbin>4) 

863 mom08simultaneous: if True, set moments=[0,8] in one call to immoments instead of two 

864 """ 

865 executionTimeSeconds = timeUtilities.time() 

866 if singleContinuum is None and vis == '': 

867 singleContinuum = False 

868 if meanSpectrumMethod not in meanSpectrumMethods: 

869 print("Unrecognized option for meanSpectrumMethod: %s" % meanSpectrumMethod) 

870 print("Available options: %s " % meanSpectrumMethods) 

871 return 

872 if useBaseline not in ['low','high','middle','auto']: 

873 print("useBaseline must be one of: low, high, middle, auto") 

874 return 

875 if img == '' and meanSpectrumFile != '' and vis != '': 

876 print("If you specify meanSpectrumFile and vis, then you must also specify img (needed only to retrieve the osbserving date and direction).") 

877 return 

878 if userJointMask != '' and amendMaskIterations != 0: 

879 print("You cannot set userJointMask at the same time as amendMaskIterations != 0") 

880 return 

881 img = img.rstrip('/') 

882 if type(centralArcsec) == str: 

883 if centralArcsec.isdigit(): 

884 centralArcsecValue = centralArcsec 

885 centralArcsec = float(centralArcsec) 

886 else: 

887 centralArcsecValue = "'"+centralArcsec+"'" 

888 else: 

889 centralArcsecValue = str(centralArcsec) 

890 if len(outdir) > 0: 

891 if not os.path.exists(outdir): 

892 print("Requested outdir does not exist.") 

893 return 

894 if meanSpectrumMethod == 'mom0mom8jointMask': 

895 validWindows = ['gauss','flat','hanning','hamming','bartlett','blackman'] 

896 if window not in validWindows: 

897 print("Invalid window: %s, must be one of: " % (window), validWindows) 

898 return 

899 if mask != '': 

900 print("The mask parameter is not relevant for meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask'. Use the userJointMask parameter instead.") 

901 return 

902 if isinstance(trimChannels, (str, np.bytes_)): 

903 trimChannelsString = "'" + trimChannels + "'" 

904 else: 

905 trimChannelsString = str(trimChannels) 

906 if isinstance(spectralDynamicRangeBandWidth, (str, np.bytes_)): 

907 spectralDynamicRangeString = "'" + spectralDynamicRangeBandWidth + "'" 

908 else: 

909 spectralDynamicRangeString = str(spectralDynamicRangeBandWidth) 

910 if isinstance(narrow, (str, np.bytes_)): 

911 narrowString = "'" + narrow + "'" 

912 else:

3219def cutSomeNarrowRanges(selection, nkeep=MAX_RANGES_FOR_IMMOMENTS, 

3220 delimiter=';'): 

3221 """ 

3222 Remove the N narrowest ranges from a channel selection string to avoid  

3223 CAS-13894 crash of immoments. 

3224 selection: e.g. '14~18;50~60' 

3225 nkeep: number of ranges to keep (failures of imstat have been seen at 244  

3226 and 245) 

3227 """ 

3228 lengths = countChannelsInRanges(selection) 

3229 ncut = len(lengths)-nkeep 

3230 if ncut < 0: 

3231 return selection 

3232 elif nkeep == 0: 

3233 return '' 

3234 casalogPost("Cutting the %d narrowest ranges to avoid CAS-13894" % (ncut)) 

3235 indexShortestFirst = np.argsort(lengths) 

3236 j = [] 

3237 for i in range(len(lengths)): 

3238 if i not in indexShortestFirst[:ncut]: 

3239 j.append(i) 

3240 selectionRanges = np.array(selection.split(';')) 

3241 selectionRanges = selectionRanges[np.array(j)] 

3242 selection = delimiter.join(selectionRanges) 

3243 return selection 

3244 

3245def gauss_kern(size): 

3246 """  

3247 Returns a normalized 2D gauss kernel array for convolutions. Used by smooth. 

3248 """ 

3249 size = int(size) 

3250 x= np.mgrid[-size:size+1] 

3251 g = np.exp(-(x**2/float(size))) 

3252 return g / g.sum() 

3253 

3254def smooth(x, window_len=10, window='hanning', verbose=False, newMethod=True): 

3255 """ 

3256 https://scipy-cookbook.readthedocs.io/items/SignalSmooth.html 

3257 Date: 2017-07-13 

3258 

3259 Smooth the data using a window with requested size. 

3260  

3261 This method is based on the convolution of a scaled window with the signal. 

3262 The signal is prepared by introducing reflected copies of the signal  

3263 (with the window size) in both ends so that transient parts are minimized 

3264 in the beginning and end part of the output signal. 

3265  

3266 input: 

3267 x: the input signal  

3268 window_len: the dimension of the smoothing window 

3269 window: the type of window from 'flat', 'hanning', 'hamming', 'bartlett', 'blackman' 

3270 flat window will produce a moving average smoothing. 

3271 

3272 output: 

3273 the smoothed signal 

3274  

3275 example: 

3276 

3277 t = linspace(-2,2,0.1) 

3278 x = sin(t)+random.randn(len(t))*0.1 

3279 y = smooth(x) 

3280  

3281 see also:  

3282  

3283 numpy.hanning, numpy.hamming, numpy.bartlett, numpy.blackman, numpy.convolve 

3284 scipy.signal.lfilter 

3285  

3286 TODO: the window parameter could be the window itself if an array instead of a string  

3287 """ 

3288 

3289 if x.ndim != 1: 

3290 raise ValueError("smooth only accepts 1 dimension arrays.") 

3291 

3292 if x.size < window_len: 

3293 raise ValueError("Input vector needs to be bigger than window size.") 

3294 

3295 if window_len < 3: 

3296 if verbose: 

3297 print("Returning unsmoothed input data") 

3298 return x 

3299 

3300 if not window in ['flat', 'hanning', 'hamming', 'bartlett', 'blackman', 'gauss']: 

3301 raise ValueError("Window is on of 'flat', 'hanning', 'hamming', 'bartlett', 'blackman', 'gauss'") 

3302 

3303 if newMethod: # superior 

3304 s = np.r_[x[window_len:0:-1], x, x[-2:-window_len:-1]] 

3305 else: # this method introduces rollups or rolldowns at the edges 

3306 s = np.r_[2*x[0]-x[window_len:1:-1], x, 2*x[-1]-x[-1:-window_len:-1]] 

3307 if verbose: 

3308 print("kernel length: %d, window_len: %d, data_len: %d" % (len(s), window_len, len(x))) 

3309 

3310 if window == 'flat': #moving average 

3311 w = np.ones(window_len,'d') 

3312 elif window == 'gauss': 

3313 w = gauss_kern(window_len) 

3314 else: 

3315 w = getattr(np, window)(window_len) 

3316 y = np.convolve(w/w.sum(), s, mode='same') 

3317 return y[window_len-1:-window_len+1]

3319def robustMADofContinuumRanges(myChannelList, myIntensity): 

3320 """ 

3321 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3322 myChannelList: subset of channels that are currently the continuum selection 

3323 intensity: list of intensities in *all* channels of the spectrum 

3324 """ 

3325 intensity = copy.deepcopy(myIntensity) # prevent changing the input! 

3326 totalChannels = len(intensity) 

3327 intensityInFCSubset = intensity[myChannelList] 

3328 medianFCSubset = np.median(intensityInFCSubset) 

3329 casalogPost('Median of the %d continuum channels: %f' % (len(myChannelList), medianFCSubset)) 

3330 if len(myChannelList) >= 10: 

3331# Original simpler method:  

3332# scaledMADFCSubset = MAD(intensityInFCSubset) 

3333# casalogPost('using MAD of the %d continuum channels: %f' % (len(myChannelList),scaledMADFCSubset)) 

3334 # This method removes the effect of a slope in the baseline on the MAD 

3335 myChannelLists = splitListIntoContiguousLists(myChannelList) 

3336 MADs = [] 

3337 Medians = [] 

3338 for mylist in myChannelLists: 

3339 Medians.append(np.median(intensity[mylist])) 

3340 MADs.append(MAD(intensity[mylist])) 

3341 scaledMADFCSubset = np.median(MADs) / np.sqrt(2) 

3342 snr = (np.max(intensityInFCSubset)-medianFCSubset) / scaledMADFCSubset 

3343 casalogPost('(median of the MADs)/sqrt(2) of the %d ranges: %f' % (len(myChannelLists),scaledMADFCSubset)) 

3344 casalogPost('old SNR = (peak-median)/medianMAD = %f' % (snr)) 

3345 

3346 # But taking the MAD of very narrow ranges (width 2-4 channels) will severely underestimate the true MAD 

3347 # So we should go back to using all channels at once. In order to still be able to remove the effect of 

3348 # a slope in the baseline, we could do a linear fit to all of their median values if len(myChannelLists) > 1. 

3349 if len(myChannelLists) > 1: 

3350 slope, intercept = linfit(np.arange(len(Medians)), np.array(Medians), np.array(Medians)*0.01) 

3351 casalogPost('slope=%f, intercept=%f' % (slope,intercept)) 

3352 for i,mylist in enumerate(myChannelLists): 

3353 bias = intercept + slope*i 

3354# casalogPost('subtracting bias = %f' % (bias)) 

3355 intensity[mylist] -= bias 

3356 intensityInFCSubset = intensity[myChannelList] 

3357 scaledMADFCSubset = MAD(intensityInFCSubset) # dividing by 3 makes it close to the prior method for G35.03 spw27 

3358 casalogPost('MAD of all FC channels together = %f, 1/3 of that = %f' % (MAD(intensityInFCSubset), scaledMADFCSubset/3)) 

3359 intensityInFCSubset += medianFCSubset # restore the global median of all FC channels 

3360 snr = (np.max(intensityInFCSubset)-medianFCSubset) / scaledMADFCSubset 

3361 casalogPost('new SNR = (peak-median) / MAD = %f' % (snr)) 

3362 idx = np.argsort(intensityInFCSubset) 

3363 npts = len(myChannelList) 

3364 nBaselineChannels = int(np.ceil(0.19 * npts)) 

3365 # If there are strong lines in the "continuum" regions, then the MAD can be not representative 

3366 # So we examine the 19% lowest channels instead 

3367 if nBaselineChannels > 35 and snr > 4: # put the cutoff between TDM and FDM240 (35/.19=184chan) 

3368 mad = MAD(intensityInFCSubset[idx][:nBaselineChannels]) 

3369# percentile = 100.0*nBaselineChannels / totalChannels 

3370 correctionFactor = 1.0 # sigmaCorrectionFactor('min', npts, percentile) 

3371 newMAD = mad * correctionFactor 

3372 casalogPost('Because there is significant signal in the continuum-free ranges, computing the MAD inferred from the lowest %d channels: %f (using correctionFactor=%f)' % (nBaselineChannels, newMAD, correctionFactor)) 

3373 if newMAD < scaledMADFCSubset: 

3374 newMedianFCSubset = np.median(intensityInFCSubset[idx][:nBaselineChannels]) 

3375 casalogPost('Because the MAD is lower, computing the MAD and median (%f) of the baseline channels.' % (newMedianFCSubset)) 

3376 scaledMADFCSubset = np.mean([scaledMADFCSubset, newMAD]) 

3377 medianFCSubset = np.mean([medianFCSubset, newMedianFCSubset]) 

3378 casalogPost('Using the mean of the two methods: median=%f MAD=%f' % (medianFCSubset, scaledMADFCSubset)) 

3379# medianFCSubset = medianCorrected('min', percentile, np.median(intensityInFCSubset[idx][:nBaselineChannels]),  

3380# scaledMADFCSubset, 1, True) 

3381# casalogPost('Inferred median = %f' % (medianFCSubset)) 

3382 else: # there are too few channels to compute a reliable MAD 

3383 casalogPost('using MAD of all channels because there are too few channels in line-free regions (%d)' % (len(myChannelList))) 

3384 scaledMADFCSubset = MAD(intensity) 

3385 return scaledMADFCSubset, medianFCSubset

3405def compute4LetterCodeAndUpdateLegend(mom8fcPeak, mom8fcPeak0, mom8fcPeakOutside, 

3406 mom8fcPeakOutside0, mom8fcSum, mom8fcSum0, 

3407 mom8fcMAD, mom8fcMAD0, thresholdForSame, areaString, 

3408 labelDescs, fontsize, ax1, amendMaskDecision, 

3409 extraMaskDecision, extraMaskDecision2, autoLowerDecision, 

3410 intersectionOfSelections, 

3411 useMomentDiff, warnings, channelRanges, sigmaUsedToAmendMask, momDiffSNR=0, 

3412 skipDecisionCode=False, replace=False, addedSelection=False, 

3413 autoLower2Decision=False, amendMaskIterations=4): 

3414 """ 

3415 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3416 Add a variable length code and a 4-letter code to the end of the last line of the upper legend. 

3417 useMomentDiff: specified in the call to findContinuum() 

3418 Returns: labelDescs, areaString, mycode 

3419 """ 

3420 casalogPost('compute4LetterCodeAndUpdateLegend: replace=%s' % replace) 

3421 if replace: 

3422 areaString = areaString.split(',')[0] 

3423 if not skipDecisionCode: 

3424 decisionCode = '' 

3425 print("amend=%s, extra=%s, extra2=%s, autoLower=%s" % (amendMaskDecision, extraMaskDecision, extraMaskDecision2, autoLowerDecision)) 

3426 if amendMaskDecision in ['No',False]: 

3427 if extraMaskDecision in ['No',False]: 

3428 if sigmaUsedToAmendMask == AMENDMASK_PIXEL_RATIO_EXCEEDED: 

3429 casalogPost("Adding ', PR' to the plot legend") 

3430 decisionCode += ', PR' 

3431 elif sigmaUsedToAmendMask == AMENDMASK_PIXELS_ABOVE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED: 

3432 casalogPost("Adding ', P#' to the plot legend") 

3433 decisionCode += ', P#' 

3434 else: 

3435 casalogPost("Adding ', S' to the plot legend") 

3436 decisionCode += ', S' 

3437 elif extraMaskDecision == 'NoImprovement': 

3438 casalogPost("Adding ', Se' to the plot legend") 

3439 decisionCode += ", Se" 

3440 elif extraMaskDecision == 'YesMom': 

3441 casalogPost("Adding ', ED' to the plot legend") 

3442 decisionCode += ', ED' 

3443 elif extraMaskDecision == 'YesCube': 

3444 casalogPost("Adding ', EC' to the plot legend") 

3445 decisionCode += ', EC' 

3446 else: 

3447 decisionCode += ', A' 

3448 if amendMaskDecision == 'YesMom': 

3449 if useMomentDiff: 

3450 decisionCode += 'D' 

3451 else: 

3452 decisionCode += '8' 

3453 elif amendMaskDecision == 'YesCube': 

3454 decisionCode += 'C' 

3455 if extraMaskDecision in ['YesMom','YesCube'] or extraMaskDecision2 in ['YesMom','YesCube']: 

3456# if extraMaskDecision in ['YesMom','YesCube']: 

3457# decisionCode += 'E' 

3458 if intersectionOfSelections: 

3459 decisionCode += 'I' 

3460 if extraMaskDecision2 in ['YesMom','YesCube']: 

3461 decisionCode += 'E' 

3462 else: 

3463 decisionCode += 'E' 

3464 elif intersectionOfSelections: 

3465 # this will only happen if findContinuum was run with amendMaskIterations=1 instead of 2 

3466 decisionCode += 'I' 

3467 if autoLowerDecision in ['YesMom','YesCube']: 

3468 decisionCode += 'X' 

3469 elif autoLowerDecision == 'NoImprovement': 

3470 decisionCode += 'x' 

3471 elif autoLowerDecision not in ['No',False]: 

3472 decisionCode += '?' 

3473 if amendMaskIterations > 3: 

3474 print("autoLower2Decision = ", autoLower2Decision) 

3475 if autoLower2Decision in ['YesMom','YesCube']: 

3476 decisionCode += 'Y' 

3477 elif autoLower2Decision == 'NoImprovement': 

3478 decisionCode += 'y' 

3479 elif autoLower2Decision not in ['No',False]: 

3480 decisionCode += '?' 

3481 if addedSelection: 

3482 decisionCode += '+' # added a selection of channels at the end due to LowBW/LowSpread 

3483 areaString += decisionCode 

3484 casalogPost('Decision code: %s' % (decisionCode.split(',')[1])) 

3485 mycode = compute4LetterCode(mom8fcPeak, mom8fcPeak0, mom8fcPeakOutside, 

3486 mom8fcPeakOutside0, mom8fcSum, mom8fcSum0, 

3487 mom8fcMAD, mom8fcMAD0, thresholdForSame) 

3488 areaString += ', ' + mycode + ', difSNR=%.1f' % (momDiffSNR) 

3489 if not skipDecisionCode: 

3490 for warning in warnings: 

3491 if warning.find('amount') > 0: 

3492 areaString += ', LowBW' 

3493 if warning.find('spread') > 0: 

3494 areaString += ', LowSpread' 

3495 myaxis = pl.gca() 

3496 for f in myaxis.texts: 

3497 casalogPost("Label: %s" % (f.get_text())) 

3498 labelDescs[-1].remove() 

3499 token = areaString.split(';') 

3500 areaString = ';'.join([token[0], ' %d ranges'%(channelRanges), token[2]]) 

3501 casalogPost("Drawing new areaString: %s" % (areaString)) 

3502 labelDesc = ax1.text(0.5, 0.99-3*0.03, areaString, transform=ax1.transAxes, ha='center', size=fontsize+difSNRFontsizeAdjust) 

3503 labelDescs.append(labelDesc) 

3504# casalogPost("calling pl.draw") 

3505 pl.draw()

3507 return labelDescs, areaString, mycode

3509def updateChannelRangesOnPlot(labelDescs, selection, ax1, separator, avgspectrumAboveThreshold, 

3510 skipchan, medianTrue, positiveThreshold, upperXlabel, ax2, 

3511 channelWidth, fontsize=10, remove=True, nbin=1, initialPeakOverMad=-1): 

3512 """ 

3513 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3514 channelWidth: in Hz 

3515 Returns: new aggregate bandwidth in GHz 

3516 """ 

3517 if remove: 

3518 # exclude final item, which is the 3rd line of the legend 

3519# print("labelDescs: ", labelDescs) 

3520 for ld,labelDesc in enumerate(labelDescs[:-1]): 

3521# print("type(labelDesc) = ", type(labelDesc)) 

3522 if type(labelDesc) == list: # plot artists (i.e., the cyan lines) 

3523 if len(labelDesc) > 0: 

3524 labelDesc.pop(0).remove() 

3525 else: # text artists (i.e., the chan0~chan1 labels above the cyan lines) 

3526 try: 

3527 labelDesc.remove() 

3528 except: 

3529 # prevent a crash; not sure why this happens sometimes on the first call 

3530 pass 

3531 print("Calling plotChannelSelections: ", selection) 

3532 labelDescs, xyChanRange0 = plotChannelSelections(ax1, selection, separator, 

3533 avgspectrumAboveThreshold, skipchan, medianTrue, 

3534 positiveThreshold)

3536 aggregateBandwidth = computeBandwidth(selection, channelWidth, 0)

3538 upperXlabel = upperXlabel[:loc] + 'contBW: %.2f MHz' % (aggregateBandwidth * 1000) 

3539 if nbin >= NBIN_THRESHOLD: # PIPE-848 

3540 upperXlabel += ', iPoM=%.1f, nbin=%d' % (initialPeakOverMad, nbin) 

3541 casalogPost("Setting new upper x-axis label: %s" % (upperXlabel)) 

3542 ax2.set_xlabel(upperXlabel, size=fontsize) # this artist cannot be removed in CASA 5.6, so just overwrite it 

3543 return aggregateBandwidth, xyChanRange0

3579 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward.

3599 NpixMom8Median = npixels[0] 

3600 if verbose: 

3601 casalogPost("computeNpixMom8Median(): momMedian=%f, momlevel=%f, momMAD=%f, peak=%f, jointMaskTest=%s" % (mom8fcMedian, mom8level, mom8fcMAD, peak, jointMaskTest)) 

3602 casalogPost(" threshold=%f, NpixMom=%d" % (threshold,NpixMom8Median)) 

3603 return NpixMom8Median

3605def replaceLineFullRangesWithNoise(intensity, selection, median, scaledMAD): 

3606 """ 

3607 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3608 intensity: an array of intensity values of *all* channels in the spectrum 

3609 selection: a channel selection string in CASA format, whose intensities should be replaced 

3610 median: of the channels *not* in the selection string (for the noise generation) 

3611 scaledMAD: of the channels *not* in the selection string (for the noise generation) 

3612 Returns: a new intensity array, of the same dimension as the input array 

3613 """ 

3614 ranges = selection.split(';') 

3615 random.seed(2001) # A Space Odyssey (guarantees that .onlyExtraMask will get same result everytime) 

3616 for myrange in ranges: 

3617 c0,c1 = [int(i) for i in myrange.split('~')] 

3618# print("len(intensity)=%d, c0,c1 = %d,%d" % (len(intensity), c0,c1)) 

3619 peakSNR = (np.max(intensity[c0:c1+1]) - median) / scaledMAD 

3620 if peakSNR > 7: # was 15 in PL2023 (when the SNR values were anomalously high) 

3621 # Note because the continuum is still in this spectrum, it can have a slope which 

3622 # will make the MAD higher than normal, so we may need to account for this he scaledMAD  

3623 # somewhat. 

3624 intensity[c0:c1+1] = median + pickRandomErrors(c1-c0+1) * scaledMAD 

3625 casalogPost("Replacing channel range %d:%d (peakSNR=%f) with median=%f +- randomNumber*scaledMAD=%f" % (c0,c1,peakSNR,median,scaledMAD)) 

3626 else: 

3627 casalogPost("Not replacing channel range %d:%d (peakSNR=%f)" % (c0,c1,peakSNR)) 

3628 return intensity

3630def compute4LetterCode(mom8fcPeak, mom8fcPeak0, mom8fcPeakOutside, mom8fcPeakOutside0, mom8fcSum, 

3631 mom8fcSum0, mom8fcMAD, mom8fcMAD0, threshold=0.01, returnRatios=False, momDiffSNR=0): 

3632 """ 

3633 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3634 threshold: to use for Peak, PeakOutside, and Sum; double this value is used for MAD (i.e. 2%) 

3635 """ 

3636 better = '' 

3637 changeInPeakInside = (mom8fcPeak-mom8fcPeak0)/mom8fcPeak0 

3638 ratios = [] # these will be negative values when the quantity improved 

3639 ratios.append(changeInPeakInside) 

3640 if changeInPeakInside > threshold: 

3641 casalogPost('peak inside = H because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is > %f' % (mom8fcPeak,mom8fcPeak0,mom8fcPeak0,changeInPeakInside,threshold)) 

3642 better += 'H' 

3643 elif changeInPeakInside < -threshold: 

3644 casalogPost('peak inside = L because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is < -%f' % (mom8fcPeak,mom8fcPeak0,mom8fcPeak0,changeInPeakInside,threshold)) 

3645 better += 'L' 

3646 else: 

3647 casalogPost('peak inside = S because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is between -%f and +%f' % (mom8fcPeak,mom8fcPeak0,mom8fcPeak0,changeInPeakInside,threshold,threshold)) 

3648 better += 'S' 

3649 changeInPeakOutside = (mom8fcPeakOutside-mom8fcPeakOutside0)/mom8fcPeakOutside0 

3650 ratios.append(changeInPeakOutside) 

3651 if changeInPeakOutside > threshold: 

3652 casalogPost('peak outside = H because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is > %f' % (mom8fcPeakOutside,mom8fcPeakOutside0,mom8fcPeakOutside0,changeInPeakOutside,threshold)) 

3653 better += 'H' 

3654 elif changeInPeakOutside < -threshold: 

3655 casalogPost('peak outside = L because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is < -%f' % (mom8fcPeakOutside,mom8fcPeakOutside0,mom8fcPeakOutside0,changeInPeakOutside,threshold)) 

3656 better += 'L' 

3657 else: 

3658 casalogPost('peak outside = S because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is between -%f and +%f' % (mom8fcPeakOutside,mom8fcPeakOutside0,mom8fcPeakOutside0,changeInPeakOutside,threshold,threshold)) 

3659 better += 'S' 

3660 changeInSum = (mom8fcSum-mom8fcSum0)/mom8fcSum0 

3661 ratios.append(changeInSum) 

3662 if changeInSum > threshold: 

3663 casalogPost('sum = H because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is > %f ' % (mom8fcSum,mom8fcSum0,mom8fcSum0,changeInSum,threshold)) 

3664 better += 'H' 

3665 elif changeInSum < -threshold: 

3666 casalogPost('sum = L because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is < -%f ' % (mom8fcSum,mom8fcSum0,mom8fcSum0,changeInSum,threshold)) 

3667 better += 'L' 

3668 else: 

3669 casalogPost('sum = S because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is between -%f and +%f ' % (mom8fcSum,mom8fcSum0,mom8fcSum0,changeInSum,threshold,threshold)) 

3670 better += 'S' 

3671 changeInMad = (mom8fcMAD-mom8fcMAD0)/mom8fcMAD0 

3672 ratios.append(changeInMad) 

3673 madThreshold = 2*threshold 

3674 if changeInMad > madThreshold: 

3675 casalogPost('MAD = H because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is > %f ' % (mom8fcMAD,mom8fcMAD0,mom8fcMAD0,changeInMad,madThreshold)) 

3676 better += 'H' 

3677 elif changeInMad < -madThreshold: 

3678 casalogPost('MAD = L because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is < -%f ' % (mom8fcMAD,mom8fcMAD0,mom8fcMAD0,changeInMad,madThreshold)) 

3679 better += 'L' 

3680 else: 

3681 casalogPost('MAD = S because (%f-%f)/%f=%f is between -%f and +%f' % (mom8fcMAD,mom8fcMAD0,mom8fcMAD0,changeInMad,madThreshold,madThreshold)) 

3682 better += 'S' 

3683 casalogPost("4-letter code: %s" % (better)) 

3684 if returnRatios: 

3685 return better, ratios 

3686 else: 

3687 return better 

3688 

3689def cubeNoiseLevel(cube, pbcube='', mask='', percentile=50, chans='', subimage=False, imageInfo=None): 

3690 """ 

3691 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3692 Computes median of the per-channel scaled MAD within the standard noise annulus 

3693 and outside the specified mask 

3694 chans: channel selection string (passed to imstat) 

3695 mask: either mask image to use (e.g. the string passed to imstat will be '"mask" == 0') 

3696 or a proper mask string containing >, < or == 

3697 percentile: compute this percentile value of the per-channel scaled MAD 

3698 (examples: 50 = median, 90 = close to the highest value) 

3699 if it is a list, then a list of values is returned 

3700 Returns: median of MAD, median 

3701 or [list of MADs], median 

3702 """ 

3703 if not os.path.exists(cube): 

3704 print("Could not find the cube") 

3705 return 

3706 if pbcube == '': 

3707 pbcube = cube.replace('.image','.pb').replace('.residual','.pb') 

3708 if not os.path.exists(pbcube): 

3709 casalogPost("Could not find the corresponding pbcube: %s" % (pbcube)) 

3710 casalogPost("Will use the whole image (or the specified mask) to compute the MAD.") 

3711 if mask == '': 

3712 mask = cube.replace('.image','.mask').replace('.residual','.mask') 

3713 if not os.path.exists(mask): 

3714 mask = cube + '.joint.mask2' 

3715 if not os.path.exists(mask): 

3716 mask = cube + '.joint.mask' 

3717 if not os.path.exists(mask): 

3718 print("Could not find any corresponding clean mask or findContinuum jointmask") 

3719 mask = '' 

3720 if os.path.exists(pbcube): 

3721 lowerAnnulusLevel, higherAnnulusLevel = findOuterAnnulusForPBCube(pbcube, False, False, subimage, imageInfo) 

3722 if mask != '' and mask is not None: 

3723 if mask.find("==") < 0 and mask.find(">") < 0 and mask.find("<") < 0: 

3724 mask = '"'+mask+'"==0' 

3725 print(" Using mask: ", mask) 

3726 mymask = '"%s">%f && "%s"<%f && %s' % (pbcube, lowerAnnulusLevel, pbcube, higherAnnulusLevel, mask) 

3727 else: 

3728 mymask = '"%s">%f && "%s"<%f' % (pbcube, lowerAnnulusLevel, pbcube, higherAnnulusLevel) 

3729 else: 

3730 mymask = '' 

3731 print(" mymask expression = ", mymask) 

3732 results = imstat(cube, axes=[0,1,2], chans=chans, mask=mymask, stretch=True, listit=imstatListit) 

3733 cubeMedian = results['median'][0] 

3734 result = results['medabsdevmed'] 

3735 if type(percentile) != list and type(percentile) != np.ndarray: 

3736 percentile = [percentile] 

3737 cubeScaledMAD = [] 

3738 for p in percentile: 

3739 cubeScaledMAD.append(scoreatpercentile(result,p) / 0.6745) 

3740 if len(cubeScaledMAD) > 1: 

3741 return cubeScaledMAD, cubeMedian 

3742 else: 

3743 return cubeScaledMAD[0], cubeMedian 

3744 

3745def tooLittleBandwidth(selection, chanInfo, fraction=0.05): 

3746 """ 

3747 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3748 Returns: a string if there is a warning, or None if not 

3749 """ 

3750 nchan, firstFreq, lastFreq, channelWidth = chanInfo 

3751 aggBandwidthHz = computeBandwidth(selection, channelWidth, 1) * 1e9 

3752 myfraction = aggBandwidthHz/float(channelWidth*nchan) 

3753 if myfraction < fraction: # compute4LetterCodeAndUpdateLegend() keys on the presence of the word 'amount' 

3754 warning = 'WARNING: Small amount of fractional bandwidth found (%.3f < %.3f) = LowBW' % (myfraction,fraction) 

3755 casalogPost(warning, priority='WARN') 

3756 return warning 

3757 else: 

3758 casalogPost('Current fractional bandwidth is %.3f' % (myfraction)) 

3759 return None 

3760 

3761def computeSpread(selection, channelWidth): 

3762 """ 

3763 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3764 """ 

3765 ranges = selection.split(';') 

3766 for i,r in enumerate(ranges): 

3767 result = r.split('~') 

3768 if (len(result) == 2): 

3769 a,b = result 

3770 if i == 0: 

3771 startchan = int(a) 

3772 # keep extending the endchan where there is more than 1 group 

3773 endchan = int(b) 

3774 return (endchan-startchan+1)*channelWidth 

3775 

3776def tooLittleSpread(selection, chanInfo, fraction=0.33): 

3777 """ 

3778 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3779 Returns: a string if there is a warning, or None if not 

3780 """ 

3781 nchan, firstFreq, lastFreq, channelWidth = chanInfo 

3782 spread = computeSpread(selection, channelWidth) 

3783 myfraction = spread/float(nchan*channelWidth) 

3784 if myfraction < fraction: # compute4LetterCodeAndUpdateLegend() keys on the presence of the word 'spread' 

3785 warning = 'WARNING: Fractional spread of frequency coverage is small (%.3f < %.3f) = LowSpread' % (myfraction,fraction) 

3786 casalogPost(warning, priority='WARN') 

3787 return warning 

3788 return None 

3789 

3790def amendMaskYesOrNo(badAtmosphere, median, momSNR, momSNRCube, Npix, NpixBadAtm, NpixCube, 

3791 TenEventSigma, MADMomOutside, MADCubeOutside, momLevel, 

3792 momLevelBadAtm, cubeLevel, NpixCube2, fractionNegativePixels, 

3793 Npix2=None, Npix2BadAtm=None, skipCubeNoise=False, 

3794 tooManyPixels=850, verbose=True): 

3795 """ 

3796 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3797 median: median of mom8fc img if fc(useMomentDiff=False), or momDiff (mom8-mom0scaled) if useMomentDiff=True 

3798 momSNR: SNR of mom8fc img if fc(useMomentDiff=False), or momDiff (mom8-mom0scaled) if useMomentDiff=True 

3799 etc. 

3800 badAtmosphere: either a boolean or a string ('goodAtm' or 'badAtm') 

3801 momLevel: for the non-badAtmosphere case, this is passed in from momDiffLevelForProceeding  

3802 """ 

3803 AMENDMASK_PIXEL_RATIO_EXCEEDED = -1 

3804 AMENDMASK_PIXELS_ABOVE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED = -2 

3805 decision = 'No' 

3806 AmendMaskLevel = 0.0 

3807 sigmaUsed = AMENDMASK_PIXEL_RATIO_EXCEEDED 

3808 if Npix2 is not None: 

3809 if Npix2 > 0: 

3810 pixelRatio = float(Npix)/Npix2 

3811 if pixelRatio > 2.2: # IRAS16293 maser gives 2.1667, NGC6334I spw16 gives 2.333 

3812 casalogPost('Pixel ratio is too high to trigger AmendMask: %f > 2.2' % (pixelRatio)) 

3813 return decision, AmendMaskLevel, sigmaUsed 

3814 if badAtmosphere in ['badAtm',True]: 

3815 badAtmosphere = True 

3816 if fractionNegativePixels > 0.1 and NpixBadAtm > tooManyPixels: 

3817 sigmaUsed = AMENDMASK_PIXELS_ABOVE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED 

3818 casalogPost('Fraction of negative pixels (%f) > 0.1 and too many pixels (%d) above threshold to trigger AmendMask' % (fractionNegativePixels,NpixBadAtm)) 

3819 return decision, AmendMaskLevel, sigmaUsed 

3820 elif badAtmosphere in ['goodAtm',False]: 

3821 badAtmosphere = False 

3822 if fractionNegativePixels > 0.1 and Npix > tooManyPixels: 

3823 sigmaUsed = AMENDMASK_PIXELS_ABOVE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED 

3824 casalogPost('Fraction of negative pixels (%f) > 0.1 and too many pixels (%d) above threshold to trigger AmendMask' % (fractionNegativePixels,Npix)) 

3825 return decision, AmendMaskLevel, sigmaUsed 

3826 else: 

3827 casalogPost('fractionNegativePixels = %f, Npix = %d, allows it to trigger AmendMask' % (fractionNegativePixels,Npix)) 

3828 else: 

3829 casalogPost('badAtmosphere has unrecognized value = %s' % (badAtmosphere)) 

3830 sigmaUsed = 0 # this is the value that will be returned if threshold are not met 

3831 if badAtmosphere: 

3832 casalogPost("Using badAtmosphere thresholds: momLevelBadAtm=%f" % (momLevelBadAtm)) 

3833 if momSNR >= momLevelBadAtm and NpixBadAtm >= 9: 

3834 decision = 'YesMom' 

3835 sigmaUsed = 8 

3836 AmendMaskLevel = median + sigmaUsed*MADMomOutside 

3837 casalogPost('Found YesMom (BadAtm) with sigma=%g yielding AmendMaskLevel = %f' % (sigmaUsed,AmendMaskLevel)) 

3838 else: 

3839 if verbose: 

3840 print("-------------------------------------") 

3841 print("amendMaskYesOrNo(): median=%f, MADMomOutside=%f, momSNR=%f, Npix=%.f" % (median, MADMomOutside, momSNR, Npix)) 

3842 print("amendMaskYesOrNo(): momSNRCube=%f, MADCubeOutside=%f, NpixCube=%.1f" % (momSNRCube, MADCubeOutside, NpixCube)) 

3843 print("-------------------------------------") 

3844 if momSNR >= momLevel and Npix >= 9: 

3845 decision = 'YesMom' 

3846 AmendMaskLevel = median + np.max([5.5,TenEventSigma]) * MADMomOutside 

3847 sigmaUsed = np.max([5.5,TenEventSigma]) 

3848 casalogPost('Found YesMom with sigma=%g (because momSNR=%f >= momLevel=%f) yielding AmendMaskLevel = %f' % (sigmaUsed,momSNR,momLevel,AmendMaskLevel)) 

3849 elif momSNRCube >= cubeLevel and NpixCube >= 9: 

3850 if skipCubeNoise: 

3851 casalogPost('Skipping the check for AmendMask needed on the basis of MADCubeOutside (due to skipCubeNoise=True)') 

3852 else: 

3853 # Need to guard against divide by zero below, so we only assess the 

3854 # ratio if we know that NpixCube > 0, rather than making it 

3855 # a 3-term 'elif' clause above. 

3856 # The float() below is to insure real arithmetic in CASA < 6. 

3857 if float(NpixCube2)/NpixCube < 2.0: 

3858 decision = 'YesCube' 

3859 AmendMaskLevel = median + np.max([5.0,TenEventSigma]) * MADCubeOutside 

3860 sigmaUsed = np.max([5.0,TenEventSigma]) 

3861 casalogPost('YesCube: sigmaUsed = %f' % (sigmaUsed)) 

3862 return decision, AmendMaskLevel, sigmaUsed 

3863 

3864def extraMaskYesOrNo(badAtmosphere, median, momSNR, momSNRCube, NpixMom, NpixMomBadAtm, NpixCubeAnywhere,

3917def onlyExtraMaskYesOrNo(badAtmosphere, median, momDiffSNR, momDiffSNRCube, 

3918 NpixMomDiff, NpixMomDiffBadAtm, 

3919 NpixCubeAnywhere, TenEventSigma, momDiffMAD, 

3920 MADCubeOutside, cubePeak, cubeMedian, 

3921 momDiffLevel, momDiffLevelBadAtm, cubeLevel, 

3922 sigmaThreshold=7.5, npixThreshold=7, skipCubeNoise=False, verbose=True): 

3923 """ 

3924 Used in Pipeline2020 going forward. 

3925 badAtmosphere: either a boolean or a string ('goodAtm' or 'badAtm') 

3926 momDiffSNR: SNR where peak is measured over whole image (instead of outside mask),  

3927 (mom scaledMAD is in denominator) 

3928 momDiffSNRCube: SNR where peak is measured over whole image (instead of outside mask),  

3929 (cube scaledMAD is in denominator) 

3930 NpixCubeAnywhere: unused now 

3931 momDiffLevel: for the non-badAtmosphere case, this is passed in from momDiffLevelForProceeding  

3932 """ 

3933 if False: 

3934 print("***** arguments:", badAtmosphere, median, momDiffSNR, momDiffSNRCube, 

3935 NpixMomDiff, NpixMomDiffBadAtm, NpixCubeAnywhere, 

3936 TenEventSigma, momDiffMAD, MADCubeOutside, cubePeak, 

3937 cubeMedian) 

3938 decision = 'No' 

3939 onlyExtraMaskLevel = 0.0 

3940 sigmaUsed = 0 

3941 casalogPost('*******************************************') 

3942 casalogPost('npixThreshold = %d' % (npixThreshold)) 

3943 casalogPost('*******************************************') 

3944 if badAtmosphere == 'badAtm': 

3945 badAtmosphere = True 

3946 elif badAtmosphere == 'goodAtm': 

3947 badAtmosphere = False 

3948 if badAtmosphere: 

3949 sigmaUsed = 8 # to set the mask level 

3950 if momDiffSNR >= momDiffLevelBadAtm and NpixMomDiffBadAtm >= npixThreshold and ((cubePeak-cubeMedian)>sigmaThreshold*MADCubeOutside or MADCubeOutside==DISABLE_CUBE_NOISE): 

3951 decision = 'YesMom' 

3952 onlyExtraMaskLevel = median + sigmaUsed*momDiffMAD

3954 else: 

3955 casalogPost('No onlyExtraMask: momSNR=%f,NpixMomBadAtm=%.1f '%(momDiffSNR,NpixMomDiffBadAtm)) 

3956 else: 

3957 if verbose: 

3958 print("-------------------------------------") 

3959 print("onlyExtraMaskYesOrNo(): median=%f, momDiffMAD=%f, momSNRMom=%f, NpixMom=%.1f" % (median, momDiffMAD, momDiffSNR, NpixMomDiff)) 

3960 print("onlyExtraMaskYesOrNo(): momSNRCube=%f, (cubePeak=%f - cubeMedian=%f) = %f, %g*MADCubeOutside=%f" % (momDiffSNRCube, cubePeak, cubeMedian, cubePeak-cubeMedian, sigmaThreshold, sigmaThreshold*MADCubeOutside)) 

3961 print("-------------------------------------") 

3962 sigmaUsed = np.max([5.5,TenEventSigma]) # to set the mask level (when YesMom is triggered) 

3963 cubeSigmaUsed = np.max([5.0,TenEventSigma]) # to set the mask level (when YesCube is triggered) 

3964 if momDiffSNR >= momDiffLevel and NpixMomDiff >= npixThreshold and (skipCubeNoise or (cubePeak-cubeMedian)>sigmaThreshold*MADCubeOutside): 

3965 decision = 'YesMom' 

3966 onlyExtraMaskLevel = median + sigmaUsed * momDiffMAD 

3967 casalogPost('YesMom: sigmaUsed = %f because momDiffSNR=%f >= momDiffLevel=%f' % (sigmaUsed,momDiffSNR,momDiffLevel)) 

3968# elif momDiffSNRCube >= cubeLevel and NpixCubeAnywhere >= 9 and (cubePeak-cubeMedian)>sigmaThreshold*MADCubeOutside: 

3969# decision = 'YesCube' 

3970# onlyExtraMaskLevel = median + cubeSigmaUsed * MADCubeOutside 

3971# sigmaUsed = cubeSigmaUsed 

3972# casalogPost('YesCube: sigmaUsed = %f' % (sigmaUsed)) 

3973 else: 

3974# casalogPost('%s. Neither YesMom nor YesCube was triggered. ' % (decision)) 

3975 casalogPost('%s. YesMom was not triggered. ' % (decision)) 

3976 if momDiffSNR < momDiffLevel: 

3977 casalogPost(' because momDiffSNR=%f < momDiffLevel=%f' % (momDiffSNR, momDiffLevel)) 

3978 if NpixMomDiff < npixThreshold: 

3979 casalogPost(' because NpixMomDiff=%d < npixThreshold=%d' % (NpixMomDiff, npixThreshold)) 

3980 if (cubePeak-cubeMedian) <= sigmaThreshold*MADCubeOutside: 

3981 casalogPost(' because (cubePeak-cubeMedian)=%f <= (sigmaThreshold*MADCubeOutside)=%f' % (cubePeak-cubeMedian, sigmaThreshold*MADCubeOutside)) 

3982 return decision, onlyExtraMaskLevel, sigmaUsed

3984def allContinuumSelected(selection, nchan, fraction=ALL_CONTINUUM_CRITERION, 

3985 fraction2=ALL_CONTINUUM_CRITERION_TDM_FULLPOL, spw=''): 

3986 """ 

3987 Returns True if only one range is selected and that range covers sufficient 

3988 bandwidth (default fraction = 92.5%) 

3989 nchan: number of channels in the spectrum 

3990 fraction: for nchan >= 75 (default = 0.925 which is 92.5%) 

3991 fraction2: for nchan < 75 (default = 0.91) 

3992 """ 

3993 ranges = selection.split(';') 

3994 if nchan < 75: 

3995 threshold = fraction2 

3996 else: 

3997 threshold = fraction 

3998 if len(ranges) == 1: 

3999 if ranges[0].find('~') > 0: 

4000 c0,c1 = [int(i) for i in ranges[0].split('~')] 

4001 elif ranges[0] == '': 

4002 c0 = 1 

4003 c1 = 0 

4004 else: # in case a single channel is selected 

4005 c0,c1 = [int(ranges[0]),int(ranges[0])] 

4006# Require this single range to be centered: 

4007# if c0 <= fraction*nchan and c1 >= (1-fraction)*(nchan-1): 

4008# Range is not required to be centered: 

4009 myfraction = (c1-c0+1)*1.0 / nchan 

4010 if (myfraction >= threshold): 

4011 casalogPost("continuum fraction (spw%s): %d-%d: %f >= %f" % (str(spw),c0,c1,myfraction, threshold)) 

4012 return True 

4013 else: 

4014 casalogPost("continuum fraction (spw%s): %d-%d: %f < %f" % (str(spw),c0,c1,myfraction, threshold)) 

4015 return False

4017def byteDecode(buffer): 

4018 if casaVersion >= '5.9.9': 

4019 return buffer.decode('utf-8') 

4020 else: 

4021 return buffer

4023def maskArgumentMismatch(mask, meanSpectrumFile, useThresholdWithMask): 

4024 """ 

4025 This function is called by checkForMismatch. 

4026 Determines if the requested mask does not match what was used to generate  

4027 the specified meanSpectrumFile. 

4028 Returns: True or False 

4029 """ 

4030# casalogPost('Entered maskArgumentMismatch()') 

4031 grepResult = byteDecode(grep(meanSpectrumFile,'mask')[0]) 

4032 if (mask == '' or mask == False): 

4033 if (grepResult != ''): 

4034 casalogPost('Mismatch: mask was used previously, but we did not request one this time') 

4035 # mask was used previously, but we did not request one this time 

4036 return True 

4037 else: 

4038 # mask was not used previously and we are not requesting one this time 

4039 casalogPost('No mismatch: mask was not used previously and we are not requesting one this time') 

4040 False 

4041 elif (grepResult == ''): 

4042 # requested mask was not used previously 

4043 casalogPost('Mismatch: requested mask was not used previously') 

4044 return True 

4045 else: 

4046 # requested mask was used previously. Except if the new mask is a subset  

4047 # of the old name, so check for that possibility. 

4048 tokens = grep(meanSpectrumFile,mask)[0].split() 

4049 newtoken = [] 

4050 for token in tokens: 

4051 newtoken.append(byteDecode(token)) 

4052 tokens = newtoken 

4053 if mask not in tokens: 

4054 casalogPost('Mismatch: mask name not in meanSpectrumFile') 

4055 return True 

4056 else: 

4057 # check if threshold was 0.00 before and we are using one now 

4058 f = open(meanSpectrumFile,'r') 

4059 lines = f.readlines() 

4060 f.close() 

4061 token = lines[1].split() 

4062 threshold = float(token[0]) 

4063 if (useThresholdWithMask and threshold == 0.0) or (not useThresholdWithMask and threshold != 0.0): 

4064 casalogPost('Mismatch in threshold: useThresholdWithMask=%s, threshold=%f' % (useThresholdWithMask, threshold)) 

4065 return True 

4066 casalogPost('No mismatch in threshold') 

4067 return False 

4068 

4069def centralArcsecArgumentMismatch(centralArcsec, meanSpectrumFile, iteration): 

4070 """ 

4071 This function is called by checkForMismatch. 

4072 Determines if the requested centralArcsec value does not match what was used to  

4073 generate the specified meanSpectrumFile. 

4074 Returns: True or False 

4075 """ 

4076 if (centralArcsec == 'auto' or centralArcsec == -1): 

4077 if (grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=auto')[0] == '' and 

4078 grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=-1')[0] == ''): 

4079 casalogPost("request for auto but 'centralArcsec=auto' not found and 'centralArcsec=-1' not found") 

4080 return True 

4081 else: 

4082 result = grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=auto')[0] 

4083 if (iteration == 0 and result != ''): 

4084 # This will force re-run of any result that went to a smaller size. 

4085 token = result.split('=auto') 

4086 if (len(token) > 1): 

4087 if (token[1].strip().replace('.','').isdigit()): 

4088 return True 

4089 else: 

4090 return False 

4091 else: 

4092 return False 

4093 else: 

4094 return False 

4095 elif (grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=auto %s'%(str(centralArcsec)))[0] == '' and 

4096 grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=mom0mom8jointMask True')[0] == '' and 

4097 grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=mom0mom8jointMask False')[0] == '' and 

4098 grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=%s'%(str(centralArcsec)))[0] == ''): 

4099 token = grep(meanSpectrumFile,'centralArcsec=')[0].split('centralArcsec=') 

4100 # the Boolean after centralArcsec=mom0mom8jointMask is: initialQuadraticRemoved 

4101 if (len(token) < 2): 

4102 # This should never happen, but if it does, prevent a crash by returning now. 

4103 casalogPost("Did not find string 'centralArcsec=' with a value in the meanSpectrum file.") 

4104 return True 

4105 value = token[1].replace('auto ','').split()[0] 

4106 print(" value = ", value) 

4107 if value.find('mom0mom8jointMask') == 0: 

4108 return False 

4109 try: 

4110 previousRequest = float(value) 

4111 centralArcsecThresholdPercent = 2 

4112 if (100*abs(previousRequest-centralArcsec)/centralArcsec < centralArcsecThresholdPercent): 

4113 casalogPost("request for specific value (%s) and previous value (%s) is within %d percent" % (str(centralArcsec),str(previousRequest),centralArcsecThresholdPercent)) 

4114 return False 

4115 else: 

4116 casalogPost("request for specific value but 'centralArcsec=auto %s' not within %d percent" % (str(centralArcsec),centralArcsecThresholdPercent)) 

4117 return True 

4118 except: 

4119 # If there is any trouble reading the previous value, then return now. 

4120 casalogPost("Failed to parse floating point value: %s" % str(value), debug=True) 

4121 return True 

4122 else: 

4123 return False

4125def plotMeanSpectrum(meanSpectrumFile, plotfile='', selection=''): 

4126 """ 

4127 Not used by pipeline. 

4128 Reads a *.findcont.residual.meanSpectrum.<method> file and plots it as 

4129 intensity vs. channel. 

4130 plotfile: set to a string to generate a png 

4131 selection: channel selection string to draw in cyan horizontal lines, 

4132 and its median intensity as a dotted cyan line 

4133 """ 

4134 if not os.path.exists(meanSpectrumFile): 

4135 print("Could not find file: ", meanSpectrumFile) 

4136 return 

4137 f = open(meanSpectrumFile,'r') 

4138 lines = f.readlines() 

4139 f.close() 

4140 channel = [] 

4141 intensity = [] 

4142 for line in lines[3:]: 

4143 a,b,c,d = line.split() 

4144 channel.append(int(a)) 

4145 intensity.append(float(c)) 

4146 intensity = np.array(intensity) 

4147 pl.clf() 

4148 pl.plot(channel,intensity,'k-') 

4149 pl.xlabel('Channel') 

4150 pl.ylabel('Intensity') 

4151 if selection != '': 

4152 channelList = convertSelectionIntoChannelList(selection) 

4153 myChannelLists = splitListIntoContiguousLists(channelList) 

4154 cyanLevel = np.median(intensity[channelList]) 

4155 level = (np.max(intensity)-cyanLevel)/3. + cyanLevel 

4156 for myChannelList in myChannelLists: 

4157# print("myChannelList = ", myChannelList) 

4158 if len(myChannelList) < 2: # add a channel to length of line 

4159 # channel range has only one channel, so cyan line doesn't appear 

4160 myChannelList[0] = myChannelList[0]-0.5 

4161 myChannelList.append(myChannelList[-1]+1) 

4162 elif len(myChannelList) < 3: # add a channel to length of line 

4163 myChannelList[0] = myChannelList[0]-0.5 

4164 myChannelList[1] = myChannelList[1]+0.5 

4165 elif myChannelList[0] == myChannelList[1]: 

4166 # this should never happen 

4167 myChannelList[0] = myChannelList[0]-0.5 

4168 myChannelList[1] = myChannelList[1]+0.5 

4169 pl.plot(myChannelList,[level]*len(myChannelList),'c-',lw=2) 

4170 pl.plot(pl.xlim(), 2*[cyanLevel], 'c:') 

4171 pl.draw() 

4172 if plotfile != '': 

4173 if plotfile == True: 

4174 plotfile = meanSpectrumFile + '.png' 

4175 pl.savefig(plotfile) 

4176 print("Wrote ", plotfile)

4178def writeContDat(meanSpectrumFile, selection, png, aggregateBandwidth, 

4179 firstFreq, lastFreq, channelWidth, img, imageInfo, vis='', 

4180 numchan=None, chanInfo=None, lsrkwidth=None, spw='', source=''): 

4181 """ 

4182 This function is called by findContinuum. 

4183 Writes out an ASCII file called <meanSpectrumFile>_findContinuum.dat 

4184 that contains the selected channels, the png name and the aggregate  

4185 bandwidth in GHz.  

4186 Returns: name of file written 

4187 meanSpectrumFile: only used to generate the name of the .dat file, unless 

4188 firstFreq <= 0, in which case the readPreviousMeanSpectrum is called on it 

4189 (It splits off name before '.meanSpectrum' and appends _findContinuum.dat) 

4190 vis: if specified, then also write a line with the topocentric velocity ranges 

4191 spw: integer or string ID number; if specified (along with vis), then also write  

4192 a final line with the topocentric channel ranges for this spw 

4193 """ 

4194 if (meanSpectrumFile.find('.meanSpectrumFile') > 0): 

4195# contDat = meanSpectrumFile.split('.meanSpectrum')[0] + '_findContinuum.dat' 

4196 # remove meanSpectrum from the name to avoid confusion that this is not a mean spectrum file 

4197 contDat = meanSpectrumFile.replace('.meanSpectrumFile','') + '_findContinuum.dat' 

4198 else: 

4199 contDat = meanSpectrumFile + '_findContinuum.dat' 

4200 contDatDir = os.path.dirname(contDat) 

4201 if firstFreq <= 0: 

4202 result = readPreviousMeanSpectrum(meanSpectrumFile) 

4203 nchan = result[4] 

4204 firstFreq = result[6] 

4205 lastFreq = result[7] 

4206 if (firstFreq > lastFreq and channelWidth > 0): 

4207 # restore negative channel widths if appropriate 

4208 channelWidth *= -1 

4209# print("firstFreq=%f, channelWidth=%f" % (firstFreq,channelWidth)) 

4210 lsrkfreqs = 1e-9*np.arange(firstFreq, lastFreq+channelWidth*0.5, channelWidth) 

4211 if (len(contDatDir) < 1): 

4212 contDatDir = '.' 

4213 if (not os.access(contDatDir, os.W_OK) and contDatDir != '.'): 

4214 # Tf there is no write permission, then use the directory of the png 

4215 # since this has been established as writeable in runFindContinuum. 

4216 contDat = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(png), os.path.basename(contDat)) 

4217# try: 

4218 if True: 

4219 f = open(contDat, 'w') 

4220 casalogPost('writeContDat(): aggregateBandwidth = %s' % (aggregateBandwidth)) 

4221 f.write('%s %s %g\n' % (selection, png, aggregateBandwidth)) 

4222 # Now write the LSRK frequency ranges on a new line 

4223 freqRange = '' 

4224 for i,s in enumerate(selection.split(';')): 

4225 c0,c1 = [int(j) for j in s.split('~')] 

4226 minFreq = np.min([lsrkfreqs[c0],lsrkfreqs[c1]])-0.5*abs(channelWidth*1e-9) 

4227 maxFreq = np.max([lsrkfreqs[c0],lsrkfreqs[c1]])+0.5*abs(channelWidth*1e-9) 

4228 freqRange += '%.9fGHz~%.9fGHz LSRK ' % (minFreq,maxFreq) 

4229 f.write(freqRange+'\n') 

4230 if (len(vis) > 0): 

4231 # vis is a non-blank list or non-blank string 

4232 if (type(vis) == str): 

4233 vis = vis.split(',') 

4234 # vis is now assured to be a non-blank list 

4235 topoFreqRanges = [] # this will be a list of lists 

4236 frame = getFreqType(img).upper() 

4237 for v in vis: 

4238 casalogPost("Converting continuum ranges from %s to TOPO for vis = %s" % (frame,v)) 

4239 vselection = '' 

4240 for i,s in enumerate(selection.split(';')): 

4241 c0,c1 = [int(j) for j in s.split('~')] 

4242 minFreq = np.min([lsrkfreqs[c0],lsrkfreqs[c1]])-0.5*abs(channelWidth*1e-9) 

4243 maxFreq = np.max([lsrkfreqs[c0],lsrkfreqs[c1]])+0.5*abs(channelWidth*1e-9) 

4244 freqRange = '%.5fGHz~%.5fGHz' % (minFreq,maxFreq) 

4245# casalogPost("%2d) %s channelRange in cube = %s" % (i, frame, s)) 

4246# casalogPost(" %s freqRange in cube = %s" % (frame,str(freqRange))) 

4247# casalogPost(" img=%s spw=%s" % (img, str(spw))) 

4248 if img == '': 

4249 result, fromFrame = cubeFrameToTopo(img, imageInfo, freqRange, vis=v, nchan=nchan, f0=firstFreq, f1=lastFreq, chanwidth=channelWidth, source=source, spw=spw) 

4250 else: 

4251 result, fromFrame = cubeFrameToTopo(img, imageInfo, freqRange, vis=v, source=source, spw=spw) 

4252 result *= 1e-9 # convert from Hz to GHz 

4253 # pipeline calls uvcontfit with GHz label only on upper freq 

4254 freqRange = '%.5f~%.5fGHz' % (np.min(result),np.max(result)) 

4255 casalogPost(" TOPO freqRange for this vis = %s" % str(freqRange)) 

4256 if (i > 0): vselection += ';' 

4257 vselection += freqRange 

4258 f.write('%s %s\n' % (v,vselection)) 

4259 topoFreqRanges.append(vselection) 

4260 if spw != '': 

4261 for i,v in enumerate(vis): 

4262 topoChanRanges = topoFreqRangeListToChannel(freqlist=topoFreqRanges[i], spw=spw, vis=v) 

4263 f.write('%s %s\n' % (v,topoChanRanges)) 

4264 f.close() 

4265 casalogPost("Wrote %s" % (contDat)) 

4266 return contDat 

4267# except: 

4268# casalogPost("Failed to write %s" % (contDat))

4270def getFieldnameFromPipelineImageName(img, verbose=False): 

4271 """ 

4272 Extracts the field name from the pipeline image file name. 

4273 -Todd Hunter 

4274 """ 

4275 basename = os.path.basename(img) 

4276 fieldname = '' 

4277 styles = ['sci','chk','bp','ph','flux','pol'] # I am anticpating that polcal will be called pol. 

4278 for style in styles: 

4279 if basename.find('_'+style) > 0: 

4280 fieldname = basename.split('_'+style)[0] 

4281 if fieldname == '': 

4282 print("No image found of these styles: ", styles) 

4283 return fieldname 

4284 # this will now be: a_Xb.s35_0.NGC300 

4285 fieldname = fieldname.split('_0.')[1] 

4286 fieldname = fieldname.strip('_') 

4287 return fieldname

4289def getSpwFromPipelineImageName(img, verbose=False): 

4290 """ 

4291 Extracts the spw ID from the pipeline image file name. 

4292 -Todd Hunter 

4293 """ 

4294 sourceName = os.path.basename(img.rstrip('/')) 

4295 if (sourceName.find('.mfs.') < 0): 

4296 if (sourceName.find('.cube.') < 0): 

4297 return 'sourcename' 

4298 else: 

4299 sourceName = sourceName.split('.cube.')[0] 

4300 else: 

4301 sourceName = sourceName.split('.mfs.')[0] 

4302 if sourceName.find('.virtspw') > 0: # PIPE-1105 

4303 sourceName = sourceName.split('.virtspw')[1].split('.')[0] 

4304 else: 

4305 sourceName = sourceName.split('.spw')[1].split('.')[0] 

4306 if sourceName.isdigit(): 

4307 return int(sourceName) 

4308 else: 

4309 return None
