4311def combineContDat(contdatlist, outputfile='cont.dat', fieldname='', spw=''): 

4312 """ 

4313 Takes a list of *.dat files created by findContinuum for a single field/spw 

4314 and pulls the line that contains LSRK frequency ranges from each one, and  

4315 writes it to a new cont.dat file suitable for the pipeline that contains an 

4316 entry for each spw of that field.  

4317 contdatlist: a list or comma-delimited string of the .dat files, or of 

4318 the cube names (to which '_findContinuum.dat' will be appended) 

4319 fieldname: use this value if specified, otherwise parse from filename 

4320 spw: integer or string integer, use this value if specified, otherwise parse 

4321 from the filename 

4322 Note: It assumes that none of the files originate from an ALLcont spw, so it will 

4323 never write the "ALL" line that the pipeline triggers on. But this feature could be 

4324 added by calling the following function if there is only one range of channels read: 

4325 allContinuumSelected(selection, nchan, fraction=ALL_CONTINUUM_CRITERION) 

4326 We would only need to know nchan. 

4327 """ 

4328 if type(contdatlist) == str: 

4329 contdatlist = contdatlist.split(',') 

4330 for c,contdat in enumerate(contdatlist): 

4331 if not os.path.exists(contdat) or os.path.isdir(contdat): 

4332 if contdat.find('.dat') < 0: 

4333 contdatlist[c] = contdat + '_findContinuum.dat' 

4334 for c,contdat in enumerate(contdatlist): 

4335 if not os.path.exists(contdat): 

4336 print("Could not find file: ", contdat) 

4337 return 

4338 o = open(outputfile,'w') 

4339 previousFieldname = '' 

4340 for contdat in contdatlist: 

4341 cube = contdat.split('_findContinuum.dat')[0] 

4342 if fieldname == '': 

4343 fieldname = getFieldnameFromPipelineImageName(cube) 

4344 if spw == '': 

4345 spw = getSpwFromPipelineImageName(cube) 

4346 f = open(contdat,'r') 

4347 lines = f.readlines() 

4348 f.close() 

4349 ranges = lines[1].split('LSRK') 

4350 if fieldname != previousFieldname: 

4351 o.write('Field: %s\n\n' % (fieldname)) 

4352 o.write('SpectralWindow: %s\n' % (str(spw))) 

4353 for myrange in ranges: 

4354 myrange = myrange.strip() 

4355 if len(myrange) > 2: # could be a line with only a few blanks 

4356 if myrange.count('GHz') > 1: 

4357 # remove GHz from the first frequency (if it is present on both) 

4358 myrange = myrange.replace('GHz', '', 1) 

4359 o.write('%s LSRK\n' % (myrange)) 

4360 o.write('\n') 

4361 o.flush() 

4362 previousFieldname = fieldname 

4363 spw = '' 

4364 o.close()

4405def computeBandwidth(selection, channelWidth, loc=-1): 

4406 """ 

4407 This function is called by runFindContinuum and findContinuum. 

4408 selection: a string of format: '5~6;9~20' 

4409 channelWidth: in Hz 

4410 Returns: bandwidth in GHz 

4411 """ 

4412 ranges = selection.split(';') 

4413 channels = 0 

4414 for r in ranges: 

4415 result = r.split('~') 

4416 if (len(result) == 2): 

4417 a,b = result 

4418 channels += int(b)-int(a)+1 

4419 aggregateBW = channels * abs(channelWidth) * 1e-9 

4420 return(aggregateBW)

4441def tdmSpectrum(channelWidth, nchan, telescope='ALMA'): 

4442 """ 

4443 This function is called by runFindContinuum and findContinuum. 

4444 Use 15e6 instead of 15.625e6 because LSRK channel width can be slightly narrower than TOPO. 

4445 Works for single, dual, or full-polarization. 

4446 channelWidth: in Hz 

4447 Returns: True or False 

4448 """ 

4449 if telescope.find('VLA') >= 0: 

4450 # PIPE-1433 requests chanwidth >= 1MHz and BW>=64 MHz 

4451 if (channelWidth >= 0.97e6) and (channelWidth*nchan >= 62e6): 

4452 casalogPost("Treating VLA spw as TDM") 

4453 return True 

4454 else: 

4455 return False 

4456 else: 

4457 if ((channelWidth >= 15e6/2. and nchan>240) or # 1 pol TDM, must avoid 240-chan FDM 

4458 (channelWidth >= 15e6)): 

4459 # (channelWidth >= 15e6 and nchan<96) or # 2 pol TDM (128 chan) 

4460 # (channelWidth >= 30e6 and nchan<96)): # 4 pol TDM (64 chan) 

4461 return True 

4462 else: 

4463 return False

4465def atmosphereVariation(img, imageInfo, chanInfo, airmass=1.5, pwv=-1, removeSlope=True, vis='', source='', spw=''): 

4466 """ 

4467 This function is called by findContinuum. 

4468 Computes the absolute and percentage variation in atmospheric transmission  

4469 and sky temperature across an image cube. 

4470 Returns 5 values: max(Trans)-min(Trans), and as percentage of mean, 

4471 Max(Tsky)-min(Tsky), and as percentage of mean,  

4472 standard devation of Tsky 

4473 """ 

4474 freqs, values = CalcAtmTransmissionForImage(img, imageInfo, chanInfo, airmass=airmass, pwv=pwv, value='transmission', vis=vis, source=source, spw=spw) 

4475 if removeSlope: 

4476 slope, intercept = linfit(freqs, values, values*0.001) 

4477 casalogPost("Computed atmospheric variation and determined slope: %f per GHz (%.0f,%.2f)" % (slope,freqs[0],values[0])) 

4478 values = values - (freqs*slope + intercept) + np.mean(values) 

4479 maxMinusMin = np.max(values)-np.min(values) 

4480 percentage = maxMinusMin/np.mean(values) 

4481 freqs, values = CalcAtmTransmissionForImage(img, imageInfo, chanInfo, airmass=airmass, pwv=pwv, value='tsky', vis=vis, source=source, spw=spw) 

4482 if removeSlope: 

4483 slope, intercept = linfit(freqs, values, values*0.001) 

4484 values = values - (freqs*slope + intercept) + np.mean(values) 

4485 TmaxMinusMin = np.max(values)-np.min(values) 

4486 Tpercentage = TmaxMinusMin*100/np.mean(values) 

4487 stdValues = np.std(values) 

4488 return(maxMinusMin, percentage, TmaxMinusMin, Tpercentage, stdValues)

4490def versionStringToArray(versionString): 

4491 """ 

4492 This function is called by casaVersionCompare. 

4493 Converts '5.3.0-22' to np.array([5,3,0,22], dtype=np.int32) 

4494 """ 

4495 tokens = versionString.split('-') 

4496 t = tokens[0].split('.') 

4497 version = [np.int32(i) for i in t] 

4498 if len(tokens) > 1: 

4499 version += [np.int32(tokens[1])] 

4500 return np.array(version) 

4501 

4502def casaVersionCompare(comparitor, versionString): 

4503 """ 

4504 This function is called by meanSpectrum. 

4505 Uses cu.compare_version in CASA5, uses string comparison in CASA4 and 6. 

4506 (but is not used by meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask' which is  

4507 the Pipeline default) 

4508 """ 

4509 if casaMajorVersion < 5: 

4510 if comparitor == '>=': 

4511 comparison = casadef.casa_version >= versionString 

4512 elif comparitor == '>': 

4513 comparison = casadef.casa_version > versionString 

4514 elif comparitor == '<': 

4515 comparison = casadef.casa_version < versionString 

4516 elif comparitor == '<=': 

4517 comparison = casadef.casa_version <= versionString 

4518 else: 

4519 print("Unknown comparitor: ", comparitor) 

4520 return False 

4521 elif casaMajorVersion == 5: 

4522 version = versionStringToArray(versionString) 

4523 comparison = cu.compare_version(comparitor, version) 

4524 else: # casa 6 

4525 if comparitor == '>=': 

4526 comparison = casaVersion >= versionString 

4527 elif comparitor == '>': 

4528 comparison = casaVersion > versionString 

4529 elif comparitor == '<': 

4530 comparison = casaVersion < versionString 

4531 elif comparitor == '<=': 

4532 comparison = casaVersion <= versionString 

4533 else: 

4534 print("Unknown comparitor: ", comparitor) 

4535 return False 

4536 return comparison

4601def removeInitialQuadraticIfNeeded(avgSpectrum, initialQuadraticImprovementThreshold=1.6): 

4602 """ 

4603 This function is called by runFindContinuum when meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask'. 

4604 Fits a quadratic to the specified spectrum, and removes it if the 

4605 MAD will improve by more than a factor of threshold 

4606 """ 

4607 index = list(range(len(avgSpectrum))) 

4608 priorMad = MAD(avgSpectrum) 

4609 casalogPost("preMad: %f" % (priorMad), debug=True) 

4610 fitResult = polyfit(index, avgSpectrum, priorMad) 

4611 order2, slope, intercept, xoffset = fitResult 

4612 myx = np.arange(len(avgSpectrum)) - xoffset 

4613 trialSpectrum = avgSpectrum + nanmean(avgSpectrum)-(myx**2*order2 + myx*slope + intercept) 

4614 postMad = MAD(trialSpectrum) 

4615# print("postMad=%e, trialSpectrum has %d non-zero values: " % (postMad,len(np.where(trialSpectrum != 0.0))), trialSpectrum) 

4616 if postMad == 0.0: 

4617 initialQuadraticRemoved = False 

4618 improvementRatio = 1.0 

4619 return avgSpectrum, initialQuadraticRemoved, improvementRatio 

4620 casalogPost("preMad: %f, postMad: %f, factorReduction: %f" % (priorMad,postMad,priorMad/postMad), debug=True) 

4621 improvementRatio = priorMad/postMad 

4622 if improvementRatio > initialQuadraticImprovementThreshold: 

4623 initialQuadraticRemoved = True 

4624 avgSpectrum = trialSpectrum 

4625 casalogPost("Initial quadratic removed because improvement ratio: %f > %f" % (improvementRatio,initialQuadraticImprovementThreshold), debug=True) 

4626 else: 

4627 casalogPost("Initial quadratic not removed because improvement ratio: %f <= %f" % (improvementRatio,initialQuadraticImprovementThreshold), debug=True) 

4628 initialQuadraticRemoved = False 

4629 return avgSpectrum, initialQuadraticRemoved, improvementRatio

4674def setYLimitsAvoidingEdgeChannels(avgspectrumAboveThreshold, mad, chan=1): 

4675 """ 

4676 Called by runFindContinuum to set the y-axis limits.. 

4677 1) Avoid spikes in edge channels from skewing the plot limits, by  

4678 setting plot limits on the basis of channels chan..-chan 

4679 2) Enforce a maximum dynamic range (peak-median)/mad so that weak features 

4680 can be seen, allowing strongest ones to overflow the top. 

4681 """ 

4682 y0,y1 = pl.ylim() 

4683 y0naturalBuffer = np.min(avgspectrumAboveThreshold) - y0 

4684 y1naturalBuffer = y1 - np.max(avgspectrumAboveThreshold) 

4685 mymin = np.min(avgspectrumAboveThreshold[chan:-chan]) - y0naturalBuffer 

4686 mymax = np.max(avgspectrumAboveThreshold[chan:-chan]) + y1naturalBuffer 

4687 mymedian = np.median(avgspectrumAboveThreshold) 

4688 highDynamicRange = False 

4689 dynamicRange = (mymax-mymedian)/mad 

4690 if dynamicRange > DYNAMIC_RANGE_LIMIT_PLOT: 

4691 mymax = DYNAMIC_RANGE_LIMIT_PLOT*mad + mymedian 

4692 casalogPost('Spectral dynamic range exceeds %d, limiting maximum y-axis value to %f' % (DYNAMIC_RANGE_LIMIT_PLOT,mymax)) 

4693 # The most common case is strong maser emission that can cause the baseline 

4694 # to appear in the upper ~quarter of the plot leaving a lot of white space 

4695 # below it. So raise the minimum to 10% of the range from true min to mymax. 

4696 mymin = np.min(avgspectrumAboveThreshold[chan:-chan]) 

4697 mymin = mymin - 0.1*(mymax-mymin) 

4698 #np.mean([-mymax,np.median(avgspectrumAboveThreshold),np.min(avgspectrumAboveThreshold)]) 

4699 casalogPost('Also limiting the minimum y-axis value to %f' % (mymin)) 

4700 highDynamicRange = True 

4701 pl.ylim([mymin, mymax]) 

4702 return highDynamicRange 

4703 

4704def ExpandYLimitsForLegend():

4710 yrange = ylim[1]-ylim[0]

4715def pickRandomErrors(nvalues=1): 

4716 """ 

4717 Picks a series of random values from a Gaussian distribution with mean 0 and standard  

4718 deviation = 1 and returns it as an array. 

4719 -Todd Hunter 

4720 """ 

4721 p = [] 

4722 for i in range(nvalues): 

4723 p.append(pickRandomError()) 

4724 return(np.array(p)) 

4725 

4726def pickRandomError(seed=None): 

4727 """ 

4728 Picks a random value from a Gaussian distribution with mean 0 and standard deviation = 1. 

4729 seed: if specified, then first reseed with random.seed(seed) 

4730 -Todd Hunter 

4731 """ 

4732 w = 1.0 

4733 if seed is not None: 

4734 random.seed(seed) 

4735 while ( w >= 1.0 ): 

4736 x1 = 2.0 * random.random() - 1.0 

4737 x2 = 2.0 * random.random() - 1.0 

4738 w = x1 * x1 + x2 * x2 

4739 

4740 w = np.sqrt( (-2.0 * np.log( w ) ) / w ) 

4741 y1 = x1 * w 

4742 y2 = x2 * w 

4743 return(y1) 

4744 

4745def createNoisyQuadratic(n=1000, nsigma=3): 

4746 """ 

4747 Function meant simply to test removeStatContQuadratic. 

4748 n: number of points in synthetic noise spectrum 

4749 nsigma: passed to removeStatContQuadratic 

4750 """ 

4751 x = np.arange(n) 

4752 y = pickRandomErrors(n) 

4753 x0 = (x - n/2) 

4754 y += 0.001*x0**2 

4755 pl.clf() 

4756 pl.plot(x,y,'k-') 

4757 y1, idx, yfit = removeStatContQuadratic(y, nsigma, returnExtra=True) 

4758 pl.plot(x,yfit,'r-') 

4759 pl.plot(x,y1,'b-') 

4760 pl.draw()

4762def removeStatContQuadratic(y, nsigma=2.0, returnExtra=False, minPercentage=50, makeMovie=False, img='', keepContinuum=True): 

4763 """ 

4764 Iteratively removes outlier points down to nsigma, then fits a quadratic to the remaining  

4765 points, removes this quadratic from the full initial spectrum, and returns it, along 

4766 with the list of channels used for the fit and the fit evaluated at all channels. 

4767 minPercentage: stop removing outliers if number of remaining goes below this threshold 

4768 makeMovie: if True, then make a png for each quadratic fit as channels are removed one-by-one 

4769 img: only used to name the movie frame pngs 

4770 """ 

4771 y = np.array(y) 

4772 x = np.arange(len(y)) 

4773 idx = np.array(x) # start with all points 

4774 yfit = np.median(y) 

4775 if makeMovie: 

4776 if img != '': 

4777 img = img + '_' 

4778 os.system('rm -f ' + img + '*') 

4779 ylim = None 

4780 diff = y[idx]-yfit 

4781 diff = diff - np.median(diff) 

4782 while np.max(np.abs(diff)) > nsigma*np.std(diff): 

4783 peak = np.argmax(np.abs(diff)) 

4784# print("Removing channel %d" % (peak)) 

4785 idx = np.delete(idx, [peak]) 

4786 if len(idx) < 3 or len(idx) < minPercentage*len(y)*0.01: 

4787 break 

4788 # fit only the remaining points  

4789 fitResult = polyfit(idx, y[idx], MAD(y[idx])) 

4790 order2, slope, intercept, xoffset = fitResult 

4791 yfit = (x[idx]-xoffset)**2*order2 + (x[idx]-xoffset)*slope + intercept 

4792 diff0 = y[idx] - yfit 

4793 diff = diff0 - np.median(diff0) 

4794 diffWithoutFit = y[idx] - np.median(y[idx]) 

4795 if np.max(yfit) - np.min(yfit) > 0: 

4796 ratio = (np.max(y[idx]) - np.min(y[idx])) / (np.max(yfit) - np.min(yfit)) 

4797 else: 

4798 ratio = 10 

4799 peakOverMAD = (np.max(y[idx]) - np.min(y[idx])) / MAD(y[idx]) 

4800 ratio = peakOverMAD 

4801 if ratio > 5: # 3*(np.max(yfit) - np.min(yfit)) < np.max(y[idx]) - np.min(y[idx]): 

4802 # strong lines are still present, so revert to using the median 

4803 fitUsed = False 

4804 diff = diffWithoutFit 

4805 else: 

4806 fitUsed = True 

4807 if makeMovie: 

4808 pl.clf() 

4809 pl.subplot(211) 

4810 pl.plot(x, y, 'k-', x[idx], yfit, 'r-', x[idx], y[idx], 'b-') 

4811 pl.plot([x[0],x[-1]], [np.median(y), np.median(y)], 'k--') 

4812 pl.title('%d points (ratio=%.2f)' % (len(idx), ratio)) 

4813 if ylim is None: 

4814 ylim = pl.ylim() 

4815 else: 

4816 pl.ylim(ylim) 

4817 pl.subplot(212) 

4818 pl.plot(x[idx], diff, 'k-') 

4819 pl.plot([x[0],x[-1]], [np.median(diff), np.median(diff)], 'k--') 

4820 if fitUsed: 

4821 pl.title('quadratic and median removed') 

4822 else: 

4823 pl.title('median removed') 

4824 png = img + 'fit%04d.png' % (len(y)-len(idx)) 

4825 pl.savefig(png) 

4826 if len(idx) < 3: 

4827 casalogPost('Too few points (%d) to fit a quadratic' % (len(idx))) 

4828 idx = x 

4829 yfit = np.zeroes(len(x)) 

4830 else: 

4831 # remove the fit from all points 

4832 yfit = (x-xoffset)**2*order2 + (x-xoffset)*slope + intercept 

4833 y = y - yfit 

4834 if keepContinuum: 

4835 y += np.mean(yfit) 

4836 if returnExtra: 

4837 return y, idx, yfit 

4838 else: 

4839 return y

4841def runFindContinuum(img='', pbcube=None, psfcube=None, minbeamfrac=0.3, 

4842 spw='', transition='', 

4843 baselineModeA='min', baselineModeB='min', 

4844 sigmaCube=3, nBaselineChannels=0.19, 

4845 sigmaFindContinuum='auto', sigmaFindContinuumMode='auto', 

4846 verbose=False, png='', pngBasename=False, 

4847 nanBufferChannels=2, 

4848 source='', useAbsoluteValue=True, trimChannels='auto', 

4849 percentile=20, continuumThreshold=None, narrow='auto', 

4850 separator=';', overwrite=False, titleText='', 

4851 maxTrim=maxTrimDefault, maxTrimFraction=1.0, 

4852 meanSpectrumFile='', centralArcsec=-1, channelWidth=0, 

4853 alternateDirectory='.', imageInfo=[], chanInfo=[], 

4854 plotAtmosphere='transmission', airmass=1.5, pwv=1.0, 

4855 channelFractionForSlopeRemoval=0.75, mask='', 

4856 invert=False, meanSpectrumMethod='peakOverMad', 

4857 peakFilterFWHM=15, fullLegend=False, iteration=0, 

4858 meanSpectrumMethodMessage='', minSlopeToRemove=1e-8, 

4859 minGroupsForSFCAdjustment=10, 

4860 regressionTest=False, quadraticFit=False, megapixels=0, 

4861 triangularPatternSeen=False, maxMemory=-1, 

4862 negativeThresholdFactor=1.15, byteLimit=-1, 

4863 singleContinuum=False, applyMaskToMask=False, 

4864 plotBaselinePoints=False, dropBaselineChannels=2.0, 

4865 madRatioUpperLimit=1.5, madRatioLowerLimit=1.15, 

4866 projectCode='', useIAGetProfile=True, 

4867 useThresholdWithMask=False, dpi=dpiDefault, 

4868 normalizeByMAD=False, overwriteMoments=False, 

4869 initialQuadraticImprovementThreshold=1.6, 

4870 minPeakOverMadForSFCAdjustment=25, 

4871 maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustment=1.20, 

4872 maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustmentInLaterIterations=1.20, 

4873 minPixelsInJointMask=3, userJointMask='', 

4874 signalRatioTier1=0.965, signalRatioTier2=0.94, 

4875 snrThreshold=23, mom0minsnr=MOM0MINSNR_DEFAULT, 

4876 mom8minsnr=MOM8MINSNR_DEFAULT, 

4877 overwriteMasks=True, rmStatContQuadratic=True, 

4878 quadraticNsigma=2, bidirectionalMaskPhase2=False, 

4879 plotQuadraticPoints=True, makeMovie=True, outdir='', 

4880 allowBluePruning=True, avoidance='', 

4881 enableRejectNarrowInnerWindows=True, 

4882 avoidExtremaInNoiseCalcForJointMask=False, 

4883 amendMask=False, momentdir='', skipchan=1, 

4884 amendMaskIterationName='', fontsize=10, vis='', 

4885 useJointMaskPrior=False, nbin=1, window='flat', 

4886 subimage=False, momDiffSNR=-1, peakOverMadCriterion=85, 

4887 maxGroups=15, # was 25 in PL2021 # was 40 earlier 

4888 momDiffApproachLevel=15.0, mom08simultaneous=True, 

4889 useUncorrectedMedian=False, 

4890 returnBluePoints=False, 

4891 removeOutlierBaselineChannels=False, 

4892 enableInitialQuadratic=False, useBaseline='auto', 

4893 spectralDynamicRangeString='', idxNonZeroMAD=None): 

4894 """ 

4895 This function is called by findContinuum. It calls functions that: 

4896 1) compute the mean spectrum of a dirty cube 

4897 2) find the continuum channels 

4898 3) plot the results 

4899 Inputs: 

4900 See description of parameters in findContinuum. 

4901 Additional inputs: 

4902 channelWidth: in Hz 

4903 iteration: order number of this call, established in calling function (findContinuum) 

4904 Returns: 23 items 

4905 *1 A channel selection string suitable for the spw parameter of clean. 

4906 *2 The name of the png produced. 

4907 *3 The slope of the linear fit (or None if no fit attempted). 

4908 *4 The channel width in Hz (only necessary for the fitsTable option). 

4909 *5 nchan in the cube (only necessary to return this for the fitsTable option, will be computed otherwise). 

4910 *6 Boolean: True if it used low values as the baseline (as opposed to high values) 

4911 *7 SNRs in the moment0 image (raw, outside mask, outside phase2 mask) 

4912 *8 SNRs in the moment8 image (raw, outside mask, outside phase2 mask) 

4913 *9 Boolean: True if the middle-valued channels were used as the baseline (as opposed to low or high) 

4914 *10 list: selectionPreBluePruning 

4915 *11 float: finalSigmaFindContinuum 

4916 *12 string: name of jointMask 

4917 *13 float array: avgspectrumAboveThreshold 

4918 *14 float: the true median of the spectrum 

4919 *15 list: of plot artist descriptors (things to potentially remove and replot) 

4920 *16 axis instance: ax1 (lower x-axis) 

4921 *17 axis instance: ax2 (upper x-axis) 

4922 *18 float: threshold (the positive threshold for line detection) 

4923 *19 string: final line of upper text legend 

4924 *20 int: number of narrow central groups that were dropped (or would have been dropped 

4925 if enableRejectNarrowWindows had been True, but wasn't), summed over all runs 

4926 of findContinuumChannels()  

4927 *21 float: effectiveSigma (product of finalSigmaFindContinuum*correctionFactor) 

4928 *22 float: baselineMAD 

4929 *23 string: upper x-axis label 

4930 *24 list of int: allBaselineChannelsXY (channel numbers of baseline) 

4931 *25 int: nbin 

4932 *26 float: initialPeakOverMad 

4933 *27 float or None: negativeThreshold 

4934 Inputs: 

4935 img: the image cube to operate upon 

4936 spw: the spw name or number to put in the x-axis label 

4937 transition: the name of the spectral transition (for the plot title) 

4938 baselineModeA: 'min' or 'edge', method to define the baseline in meanSpectrum() 

4939 sigmaCube: multiply this value by the MAD to get the threshold above which a pixel 

4940 is included in the mean spectrum 

4941 nBaselineChannels: if integer, then the number of channels to use in: 

4942 a) computing the mean spectrum with the 'meanAboveThreshold' methods. 

4943 b) computing the MAD of the lowest/highest channels in findContinuumChannels 

4944 if float, then the fraction of channels to use (i.e. the percentile) 

4945 default = 0.19, which is 24 channels (i.e. 12 on each side) of a TDM window 

4946 sigmaFindContinuum: passed to findContinuumChannels, 'auto' starts with 3.5 

4947 sigmaFindContinuumMode: 'auto', 'autolower', or 'fixed' 

4948 verbose: if True, then print additional information during processing 

4949 png: the name of the png to produce ('' yields default name) 

4950 pngBasename: if True, then remove the directory from img name before generating png name 

4951 nanBufferChannels: when removing or replacing NaNs, do this many extra channels 

4952 beyond their extent 

4953 source: the name of the source, to be shown in the title of the spectrum. 

4954 if None, then use the filename, up to the first underscore. 

4955 findContinuum: if True, then find the continuum channels before plotting 

4956 overwrite: if True, or ASCII file does not exist, then recalculate the mean spectrum 

4957 writing it to <img>.meanSpectrum 

4958 if False, then read the mean spectrum from the existing ASCII file 

4959 trimChannels: after doing best job of finding continuum, remove this many  

4960 channels from each edge of each block of channels found (for margin of safety) 

4961 If it is a float between 0..1, then trim this fraction of channels in each  

4962 group (rounding up). If it is 'auto', use 0.1 but not more than maxTrim channels 

4963 and not more than maxTrimFraction 

4964 percentile: control parameter used with baselineMode='min' 

4965 continuumThreshold: if specified, only use pixels above this intensity level 

4966 narrow: the minimum number of channels that a group of channels must have to survive 

4967 if 0<narrow<1, then it is interpreted as the fraction of all 

4968 channels within identified blocks 

4969 if 'auto', then use int(ceil(log10(nchan))) 

4970 titleText: default is img name and transition and the control parameter values 

4971 meanSpectrumFile: an alternative ASCII text file to use for the mean spectrum. 

4972 Must also set img=''. 

4973 meanSpectrumMethod: 'peakOverMad', 'peakOverRms', 'meanAboveThreshold',  

4974 'meanAboveThresholdOverRms', 'meanAboveThresholdOverMad',  

4975 where 'peak' refers to the peak in a spatially-smoothed version of cube 

4976 peakFilterFWHM: value used by 'peakOverRms' and 'peakOverMad' to presmooth  

4977 each plane with a Gaussian kernel of this width (in pixels) 

4978 Set to 1 to not do any smoothing. 

4979 centralArcsec: radius of central box within which to compute the mean spectrum 

4980 default='auto' means start with whole field, then reduce to 1/10 if only 

4981 one window is found (unless mask is specified); or 'fwhm' for the central square 

4982 with the same radius as the PB FWHM; or a floating point value in arcseconds 

4983 mask: a mask image equal in shape to the parent image that is used to determine the 

4984 region to compute the noise (outside the mask) and the mean spectrum (inside the mask) 

4985 option 'auto' will look for the <filename>.mask that matches the <filename>.image 

4986 and if it finds it, it will use it; otherwise it will use no mask 

4987 plotAtmosphere: '', 'tsky', or 'transmission' 

4988 airmass: for plot of atmospheric transmission 

4989 pwv: in mm (for plot of atmospheric transmission) 

4990 channelFractionForSlopeRemoval: if at least this many channels are initially selected, or  

4991 if there are only 1-2 ranges found and the widest range has > nchan*0.3 channels, then  

4992 fit and remove a linear slope and re-identify continuum channels. Set to 1 to turn off. 

4993 quadraticFit: if True, fit quadratic polynomial to the noise regions when appropriate;  

4994 otherwise fit only a linear slope 

4995 megapixels: simply used to label the plot 

4996 triangularPatternSeen: if True, then slightly boost sigmaFindContinuum if it is in 'auto' mode 

4997 maxMemory: only used to name the png if it is set 

4998 applyMaskToMask: if True, apply the mask inside the user mask image to set its masked pixels to 0 

4999 plotBaselinePoints: if True, then plot the baseline-defining points as black dots 

5000 dropBaselineChannels: percentage of extreme values to drop in baseline mode 'min' 

5001 useIAGetProfile: if True, then for meanAboveThreshold and baselineMode='min', then 

5002 use ia.getprofile instead of ia.getregion and subsequent arithmetic (faster) 

5003 initialQuadraticImprovementThreshold: if removal of a quadratic from the raw meanSpectrum reduces 

5004 the MAD by this factor or more, then proceed with removing this quadratic (new Cycle 6 heuristic) 

5005 maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustment: madRatio must be below this value (among other things) in order 

5006 for automatic lowering of sigmaFindContinuum value to occur in .original iteration 

5007 maxMadRatioForSFCAdjustmentInLaterIterations: madRatio must be below this value (among other things) in order 

5008 for automatic lowering of sigmaFindContinuum value to occur in later iterations 

5009 avoidance: a CASA channel selection string to avoid selecting for continuum (for  

5010 manual use); invoked just before making the plot and returning 

5011 

5012 Parameters only relevant to mom0mom8jointMask: 

5013 mom0minsnr: sets the threshold for the mom0 image (i.e. median + mom0minsnr*scaledMAD) 

5014 mom8minsnr: sets the threshold for the mom8 image (i.e. median + mom8minsnr*scaledMAD) 

5015 snrThreshold: if SNR is higher than this, and phase2==True, then run a phase 2 mask calculation 

5016 minPixelsInJointMask: if fewer than these pixels are found, then use all pixels above pb=0.3 

5017 (when meanSpectrumMethod = 'mom0mom8jointMask') 

5018 overwriteMoments: if True, then overwrite any existing moment0 or moment8 image  

5019 overwriteMasks: if True, then overwrite any existing moment0 or moment8 mask image  

5020 enableInitialQuadratic: if True, assess the need for quadratic removal, and use the  

5021 old-style method to remove it 

5022 rmStatContQuadratic: if True, then do not do the initialQuadratic removal (if  

5023 enabled and deemed necessary), but instead always perform the new-style  

5024 quadratic removal 

5025 quadraticNsigma: the stopping threshold to use when ignoring outliers prior to fitting 

5026 fitting the quadratic (in the rmStatContQuadratic option). To more quickly test  

5027 different values, be sure to set the meanSpectrumFile option and overwrite=False) 

5028 bidirectionalMaskPhase2: True=extend mask to negative values beyond threshold; False=Cycle6 behavior 

5029 makeMovie: if True, then make a png for each quadratic fit as channels are  

5030 removed one-by-one (in the rmStatContQuadratic option) 

5031 outdir: where to write the .mom0 and .mom8 images, .dat, meanSpectrum, and the .png file 

5032 maxGroups: maximum number of continuum regions below which the potential reduction  

5033 factor of sigmaFindContinuum will be scaled by (1 - groups/maxGroups)**(bandwidth/1875e6) 

5034 via the following equation: 

5035 sFC_factor = np.max([scalingFactor/7.0, (1-groups/float(maxGroups))**(spwBandwidth/1.875e9)]) 

5036 

5037 Parameters passed to findContinuumChannels (and only used in there): 

5038 useUncorrectedMedian: if True, then do not adjust the median (solid black line) upward 

5039 from the median of the baseline points (dashed blue line) 

5040 returnBluePoints: if True, then simply set the continuum ranges to the baseline points  

5041 (i.e. the blue points) instead of what the other heuristics might have found 

5042 baselineModeB: 'min' or 'edge', method to define the baseline in findContinuumChannels() 

5043 separator: the character to use to separate groups of channels in the string returned 

5044 maxTrim: in trimChannels='auto', this is the max channels to trim per group for TDM spws; it is automatically scaled upward for FDM spws. 

5045 maxTrimFraction: in trimChannels='auto', the max fraction of channels to trim per group 

5046 negativeThresholdFactor: scale the nominal negative threshold by this factor (to adjust  

5047 sensitivity to absorption features: smaller values=more sensitive) 

5048 signalRatioTier1: threshold for signalRatio, above which we desensitize the level to 

5049 consider line emission in order to avoid small differences in noise levels from  

5050 affecting the result (e.g. that occur between serial and parallel tclean cubes) 

5051 signalRatio=1 means: no lines seen, while closer to zero: more lines seen 

5052 signalRatioTier2: second threshold for signalRatio, used for FDM spws (nchan>192) and 

5053 for cases of peakOverMad < 5. Should be < signalRatioTier1. 

5054 dropBaselineChannels: percentage of extreme values to drop in baseline mode 'min' 

5055 madRatioUpperLimit, madRatioLowerLimit: determines when dropBaselineChannels is used 

5056 mom08simultaneous: passed to meanSpectrumFromMom0Mom8JointMask 

5057 useBaseline: 'low', 'middle', 'high' or 'auto'; auto tries to automatically pick 'low' for 

5058 spectra that are emission-line dominated, 'high' if absorption line dominated, or 'both' if 

5059 both types of lines are present

5541 # New heuristic for Cycle 6: blue pruning (a.k.a. examining blue points) 

5542 # Definition: remove any candidate continuum range 

5543 # (horizontal cyan lines in the plot) that do not contain any  

5544 # initial baseline points (blue points in the plot), and trim  

5545 # those ranges that do contain baseline points to the maximal  

5546 # extent of the enclosed baseline points, eliminating them if

5550 validSelections = []

5553 checkForGaps = True 

5554 # checkForGaps means to look for large portions of a channelSelection that has no

5556 # This is meant to eliminate the remaining weak lines in a hot core spectrum that 

5557 # are below the final threshold.

5559 validSelection = False

5567 if groups == 1: 

5568 # Enable detection of single faint narrow line,  

5569 # e.g. 42 in project 54 uid___A001_X144_X7b.s21_0.IRD_C_sci.spw29 

5570 # 58 MHz 240 chan, 15 chan -> 3.6 km/s at 300 GHz 

5571 # 58 MHz 480 chan, 30 chan -> 3.6 km/s 

5572 # 58 MHz 960 chan, 60 chan -> 3.6 km/s 

5573 # 58 MHz 960 chan, 15 chan -> 3.6 km/s at 75 GHz 

5574 gapMinThreshold = int(30*(firstFreq/300e9)*(spwBandwidth/58e6)*(nchan/480.)) # previously was 40 

5575 casalogPost('initial gapMinThreshold=%d' % (gapMinThreshold)) 

5576 if peakOverMad <= 6: # we got into here only because more than 4/5 channels were picked 

5577 if gapMinThreshold < 30: 

5578 gapMinThreshold = 30 # 30 was set to avoid gaps with no lines 

5579 elif gapMinThreshold > 45: #50: 

5580 gapMinThreshold = 45 #50 # 50 was set by E2E6.1.00030.S spw16 CO galaxy w/no continuum uid___A002_Xcff05c_X1bd.s28_0.HCG25b_sci.spw16.mfs.I.findcont.residual, but this line is 111 channels wide, so no longer appears to motivate this value 

5581 #49 was needed by 2018.1.00635.S spw29 CI1-0 

5582 else: 

5583 gapMinThreshold = np.max([16,gapMinThreshold]) # original heuristic, Note: can be a large number, even > gapMaxThreshold! 

5584 if (gapMinThreshold > gapMaxThreshold): 

5585 # this would fix two results on CAS-5290, including 2018.1.01100.S  

5586 # but has not been checked in regression 

5587 casalogPost('sFC was adjusted and gapMin=%d > gapMax=%d, so setting gapMin=30' % (gapMinThreshold,gapMaxThreshold)) 

5588 gapMinThreshold = 30 # could also try 0.06*nchan (which is 28 for 478 chan) 

5589 if gapMinThreshold > gapMaxThreshold: 

5590 casalogPost(' but new gapMin=%d > gapMax=%d, so setting gapMin=%d' % (gapMinThreshold,gapMaxThreshold,gapMaxThreshold-10)) 

5591 gapMinThreshold = gapMaxThreshold-10 

5592 else: 

5593 # Must be at least half the width of the group 

5594 gapMinThreshold = int(np.max([selectionWidth/2, narrow])) # splitgaps.pdf 

5595 

5596 if checkForGaps and verbose: 

5597 casalogPost("%s Looking for gaps in group %d/%d: %s that are %d < gap < %d" % (projectCode,i+1,len(channelSelections),ccstring,gapMinThreshold, gapMaxThreshold), debug=True) 

5598 theseChannels = list(range(cc[0], cc[1]+1)) 

5599 startChan = -1 

5600 stopChan = -1 

5601 gaps = [] 

5602 for chan in theseChannels: 

5603 if chan in allBaselineChannelsXY[0]: 

5604 validSelection = True # valid if any of the channels appeared in the original baseline 

5605 if startChan == -1: 

5606 startChan = chan 

5607 else: 

5608 # If the blue points are contiguous, then chan will now be stopChan+1, so check 

5609 # if it is actually a lot more than that (meaning we just crossed a gap). But, 

5610 # it must be a big gap relative to the selection width in order to qualify. 

5611 if ((stopChan > -1) and (chan-stopChan) > gapMinThreshold and (chan-stopChan) < gapMaxThreshold and checkForGaps): 

5612 gaps.append([stopChan+1,chan-1]) 

5613 else: 

5614 if chan-stopChan >= gapMaxThreshold:

5620 casalogPost('Removing the one gap found because the peak is not in here') 

5621 gaps = [] 

5622 tooNarrow = False

5626 validSelection = False

5645 firstChan = startChan 

5646 else:

5649 if gap[0]-firstChan >= narrow:

5660 newGroups += 1 

5661 validSelections.append(ccstring) 

5662 newContinuumChannels += list(range(gaps[len(gaps)-1][1]+1, stopChan+1)) 

5663 casalogPost(' %s Defining range %s' % (projectCode,ccstring), debug=True) 

5664 else: 

5665 casalogPost(' %s Skipping range %s because it is too narrow (<%d)' % (projectCode,ccstring,narrow), debug=True) 

5666 # end for i,ccstring in enumerate(channelSelections) 

5667 if newGroups > 0: 

5668 selection = separator.join(validSelections)

5670 continuumChannels = newContinuumChannels 

5671 else:

5679 if groups == 1: 

5680 if selection == '': 

5681 print("This should not happen since PIPE-359 was fixed.") 

5682 if not amendMask: 

5683 return 

5684 channelsInSingleGroup = 0 

5685 group0 = [-1,-1] 

5686 else: 

5687 group0 = [int(j) for j in selection.split(',')[0].split('~')] 

5688 channelsInSingleGroup = np.abs(np.diff(group0))[0] + 1 

5689 minPercentInSingleGroup = 5.0 

5690 if float(channelsInSingleGroup)/nchan < minPercentInSingleGroup/100: 

5691 percentage = 100.*channelsInSingleGroup / nchan 

5692 casalogPost(' %s ****** There is only a single channel range found with only %.1f%% (< %.0f%%) of the channels' % (projectCode,percentage,minPercentInSingleGroup)) 

5693 whichHalf = np.mean(group0) < nchan/2 

5694 mylist = findWidestContiguousListInOtherHalf(allBaselineChannelsXY[0], whichHalf, nchan) 

5695 if mylist is not None:

5699 selection = secondSelectionAdded 

5700 else: 

5701 lastChannelOfOnlyRegion = int(selection.split('~')[-1]) 

5702 if mylist[0] > lastChannelOfOnlyRegion: # allBaselineChannelsXY[0][-1]: 

5703 # add to end of string (to maintain increasing order) 

5704 print("Adding to end of string") 

5705 selection += separator + secondSelectionAdded

6271def invertChannelRanges(invertstring, nchan=0, startchan=0, vis='', spw='', 

6272 separator=';'): 

6273 """ 

6274 Takes a CASA channel selection string and inverts it. 

6275 -Todd Hunter 

6276 """ 

6277 myspw = spw 

6278 checkForMultipleSpw = invertstring.split(',') 

6279 mystring = '' 

6280 if (vis != ''): 

6281 mymsmd = msmdtool() 

6282 mymsmd.open(vis) 

6283 for c in range(len(checkForMultipleSpw)): 

6284 checkspw = checkForMultipleSpw[c].split(':') 

6285 if (len(checkspw) > 1 and spw==''): 

6286 spw = checkspw[0] 

6287 checkForMultipleSpw[c] = checkspw[1] 

6288 if (vis != ''): 

6289 nchan = mymsmd.nchan(int(spw)) 

6290# print "Setting nchan = %d for spw %s" % (nchan,str(spw)) 

6291 goodstring = checkForMultipleSpw[c] 

6292 goodranges = goodstring.split(separator) 

6293 if (str(spw) != ''): 

6294 mystring += str(spw) + ':' 

6295 if (int(goodranges[0].split('~')[0]) > startchan): 

6296 mystring += '%d~%d%s' % (startchan,int(goodranges[0].split('~')[0])-1, separator) 

6297 multiWindows = False 

6298 for g in range(len(goodranges)-1): 

6299 r = goodranges[g] 

6300 s = goodranges[g+1] 

6301 mystring += '%d~%d' % (int(r.split('~')[1])+1, int(s.split('~')[0])-1) 

6302 multiWindows = True 

6303 if (g < len(goodranges)-2): 

6304 mystring += separator 

6305 if (int(goodranges[-1].split('~')[-1]) < startchan+nchan-1): 

6306 if (multiWindows): 

6307 mystring += separator 

6308 mystring += '%d~%d' % (int(goodranges[-1].split('~')[-1])+1, startchan+nchan-1) 

6309 if (c < len(checkForMultipleSpw)-1): 

6310 mystring += ',' 

6311 spw = myspw # reset to the initial value 

6312 if (vis != ''): 

6313 mymsmd.close() 

6314 return(mystring)

6316def plotChannelSelections(ax1, selection, separator, avgspectrumAboveThreshold, 

6317 skipchan, medianTrue, 

6318 threshold, secondSelectionAdded='', lineColor='c'): 

6319 """ 

6320 avgspectrumAboveThreshold: computed in runFindContinuum 

6321 medianTrue, threshold: computed by findContinuumChannels 

6322 Returns labelDescs: list of plot artists that may be removed and replaced later 

6323 """ 

6324 labelDescs = [] 

6325 channelSelections = selection.split(separator) 

6326# ylevel = np.mean(avgspectrumAboveThreshold) # Cycle 0-5 heuristic 

6327 peak = np.max(avgspectrumAboveThreshold[skipchan:-skipchan]) 

6328 if (peak-medianTrue) > 1.5*(threshold-medianTrue): 

6329 ylevel = threshold + (threshold-medianTrue)*np.log10((peak-medianTrue)/(threshold-medianTrue)) 

6330 print("Setting cyan level (%f) to just above the positive threshold dotted line" % (ylevel)) 

6331 else: 

6332 ylevel = threshold - 0.5*(threshold-medianTrue) 

6333 print("Setting cyan level to half the positive threshold dotted line") 

6334 yoffset = ylevel + 0.04*(pl.ylim()[1]-pl.ylim()[0]) 

6335 for i,ccstring in enumerate(channelSelections): 

6336 cc = [int(j) for j in ccstring.split('~')] 

6337 # length of cc will always be at least 2 

6338 mywidth = cc[1]-cc[0] # can be 0 or larger 

6339 if (mywidth < 2): 

6340# print("Widening cyan line by %d: " % (2-mywidth)) 

6341 cc[0] = cc[0] - (2-mywidth)*0.5 

6342 cc[1] = cc[1] + (2-mywidth)*0.5 

6343 mylw = 1.33 

6344 else: 

6345 mylw = 2 

6346 labelDesc = ax1.plot(cc, np.ones(len(cc))*ylevel, '-', color=lineColor, lw=mylw) 

6347 labelDescs.append(labelDesc) 

6348 mystring = ccstring 

6349 if i==1 and secondSelectionAdded != '': 

6350 # indicate if the heuristic for CAS-11720 was activated to ensure a second region 

6351 mystring += ' added' 

6352 labelDesc = ax1.text(np.mean(cc), yoffset, mystring, va='bottom', ha='center',size=8,rotation=90) 

6353 labelDescs.append(labelDesc) 

6354 if len(labelDescs) > 1: 

6355 tcbox = pl.gca().transData.inverted().transform(labelDescs[1].get_window_extent()) 

6356 xyChanRange0 = tcbox # np.mean(tcbox, axis=0) 

6357 else: 

6358 xyChanRange0 = None 

6359 return labelDescs, xyChanRange0

6361def findWidestContiguousListInOtherHalf(channels, lowerHalf, nchan): 

6362 """ 

6363 Given a list of channels, find the longest contiguous list in the first half or second half 

6364 example: 

6365 CASA <43>: fc.findWidestContiguousListInOtherHalf([2,3,7,8,9,12,13,14,15], True, 20) 

6366 Out[43]: [12, 13, 14, 15] 

6367 channels: list of blue points channel numbers 

6368 lowerHalf: a Boolean (True for lower half, False for upper half) 

6369 nchan: total channels in spectrum 

6370 """ 

6371 contiguousLists = splitListIntoContiguousLists(sorted(channels)) 

6372 mylengths = [] 

6373 widestList = None 

6374 widestListLength = 0 

6375 for j,contiguousList in enumerate(contiguousLists): 

6376 mylengths.append(0) 

6377 if (lowerHalf and contiguousList[0] >= nchan/2) or (not lowerHalf and contiguousList[0] < nchan/2): 

6378 mylengths[j] = len(contiguousList) 

6379 if mylengths[j] > widestListLength: 

6380 widestListLength = mylengths[j] 

6381 widestList = contiguousList 

6382 return widestList 

6383 

6384def findChannelsInChannelRangeWithComparableIntensity(channels, channelRange, continuumChannels, 

6385 intensity, withinSigma=1, negativeThreshold=None, positiveThreshold=None): 

6386 """ 

6387 Finds channels in a portion of the spectrum (intensity) whose intensity is  

6388 within the range of intensities of the blue points (channels) by some sigma 

6389 beyond the min and max. 

6390 channels: list of blue points channel numbers 

6391 intensity: intensity of whole spectrum (an array) 

6392 channelRange: range of channels to look for widest set of blue points [first,final] 

6393 continuumChannels: current selection of continuuum channels 

6394 withinSigma: fix for PIPE-2188 

6395 negativeThreshold: value to use instead of the min of intensity of the blue points: PIPE-3103 

6396 positiveThreshold: value to use instead of the max of intensity of the blue points: PIPE-3103 

6397 Returns: a list of channels, possibly non-contiguous, sorted low to high 

6398 """ 

6399 if negativeThreshold is None: 

6400 imin = np.min(intensity[channels]) 

6401 else: 

6402 imin = negativeThreshold 

6403 if positiveThreshold is None: 

6404 imax = np.max(intensity[channels]) 

6405 else: 

6406 imax = positiveThreshold 

6407 newList = [] 

6408# sigma = np.std(intensity[channels]) fc <= v7.16 

6409 sigma = MAD(intensity[channels]) # fc v7.17 

6410 for channel in range(int(channelRange[0]), int(channelRange[1])): 

6411 if (imin-withinSigma*sigma) < intensity[channel] < (imax+withinSigma*sigma): 

6412 distance = np.min([imax-intensity[channel], intensity[channel]-imin])/sigma 

6413 casalogPost('Channel %d is within %.1f scaled MAD of nearest blue point intensity' % (channel,distance)) 

6414 newList.append(channel) 

6415# newLists = splitListIntoContiguousLists(sorted(newList)) 

6416 return(sorted(newList)) 

6417 

6418def findWidestContiguousListInChannelRange(channels, channelRange, continuumChannels): 

6419 """ 

6420 Given a list of channels, find the longest contiguous list in the first half or second half 

6421 example: 

6422 CASA <43>: fc.findWidestContiguousListInChannelRange([2,3,7,8,9,12,13,14,15], [10,20], [7,8,9]) 

6423 Out[43]: [12, 13, 14, 15] 

6424 channels: list of blue points channel numbers 

6425 channelRange: range of channels to look for widest set of blue points 

6426 continuumChannels: current selection of continuuum channels 

6427 Returns: a list of contiguous channels 

6428 """ 

6429 contiguousLists = splitListIntoContiguousLists(sorted(channels)) 

6430 currentRange = continuumChannels[-1]-continuumChannels[0] + 1 

6431 mylengths = [] 

6432 widestList = None 

6433 widestListLength = 0 

6434 startchan, endchan = channelRange 

6435 for j,contiguousList in enumerate(contiguousLists): 

6436 mylengths.append(0) 

6437 if (contiguousList[0] >= startchan) and (contiguousList[-1] < endchan): 

6438 spreadFactor = np.max([contiguousList[-1]-continuumChannels[0]+1,continuumChannels[-1]-contiguousList[0]+1])/currentRange 

6439 mylengths[j] = len(contiguousList) * spreadFactor 

6440 mylist = [int(i) for i in contiguousList] # convert int64 to int for shorter messages 

6441 casalogPost('Possible region: %s, %d*%f = %f' % (mylist, len(mylist), spreadFactor, mylengths[j])) 

6442 if mylengths[j] > widestListLength: 

6443 widestListLength = mylengths[j] 

6444 widestList = contiguousList 

6445 return widestList

6447def aboveBelow(avgSpectrumNansReplaced, threshold): 

6448 """ 

6449 This function is called by runFindContinuum. 

6450 Given an array of values (i.e. a spectrum) and a threshold value, this  

6451 function computes and returns 6 items:  

6452 * the number of channels above that threshold (group 1) 

6453 * the number of channels below that threshold (group 2) 

6454 * the ratio of these numbers (i.e., #ChanAboveThreshold / #ChanBelowThreshold)) 

6455 * sum of the intensities in group (1)  

6456 * sum of the intensities in group (2) 

6457 * the ratio of these sums (i.e., FluxAboveThreshold / FluxBelowThreshold) 

6458 (This value is not currently used by the calling function.) 

6459 Example with 24 channels where 3 have positive spikes, and rest are zero: 

6460 3 2 3 channelsAbove = 3 

6461 +threshold=+1 ........................ sumAbove = (3-1) + (2-1) + (3-1) = 5  

6462 zero --------------------------- channelsBelow = 21 

6463 -threshold=-1 ........................ sumBelow = 21*(1-0) = 21 

6464 """ 

6465 y = avgSpectrumNansReplaced 

6466 aboveMedian = np.where(avgSpectrumNansReplaced > threshold) 

6467 belowMedian = np.where(avgSpectrumNansReplaced < threshold) 

6468 sumAboveMedian = np.sum(-threshold+avgSpectrumNansReplaced[aboveMedian]) 

6469 sumBelowMedian = np.sum(threshold-avgSpectrumNansReplaced[belowMedian]) 

6470 channelsAboveMedian = len(aboveMedian[0]) 

6471 channelsBelowMedian = len(belowMedian[0]) 

6472 channelRatio = channelsAboveMedian*1.0/channelsBelowMedian 

6473 sumRatio = sumAboveMedian/sumBelowMedian # this value is unused by the calling function 

6474 return(sumAboveMedian, sumBelowMedian, sumRatio, 

6475 channelsAboveMedian, channelsBelowMedian, channelRatio) 

6476 

6477def writeMeanSpectrum(meanSpectrumFile, frequency, avgspectrum, 

6478 avgSpectrumNansReplaced, threshold, nchan, edgesUsed=0, 

6479 nanmin=0, centralArcsec='auto', mask='', iteration=0): 

6480 """ 

6481 This function is called by meanSpectrum. 

6482 Writes out the mean spectrum (and the key parameters used to create it),  

6483 so that it can quickly be restored. This allows the manual user to quickly  

6484 experiment with different parameters of findContinuumChannels applied to  

6485 the same mean spectrum. 

6486 Units are Hz and Jy/beam. 

6487 meanSpectrumFile: name of file to create 

6488 threshold: this is interpreted as mom0threshold for meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask' 

6489 edgesUsed: this is interpreted as numberPixelsInMask for meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask' 

6490 nanmin: this is interpreted as mom8threshold for meanSpectrumMethod='mom0mom8jointMask' 

6491 frequency: list or array of frequencies 

6492 Returns: None 

6493 """ 

6494 if len(meanSpectrumFile) == 0: 

6495 print("WARNING: blank name requested for meanSpectrumFile!!") 

6496 return 

6497 f = open(meanSpectrumFile, 'w') 

6498 if centralArcsec == 'mom0mom8jointMask': 

6499 field1 = 'mom0threshold' 

6500 field2 = 'numberPixelsInMask' 

6501 field4 = 'mom8threshold' 

6502 else: 

6503 field1 = 'threshold' 

6504 field2 = 'edgesUsed' 

6505 field4 = 'nanmin' 

6506 if (iteration == 0): 

6507 f.write('#%s %s nchan %s centralArcsec=%s %s\n' % (field1,field2,field4,str(centralArcsec),mask)) 

6508 else: 

6509 f.write('#threshold edgesUsed nchan nanmin centralArcsec=auto %s %s\n' % (str(centralArcsec),mask)) 

6510 # field1 field2 field4 

6511 f.write('%.10f %g %g %.10f\n' % (threshold, edgesUsed, nchan, nanmin)) 

6512 f.write('#chan freq(Hz) avgSpectrum avgSpectrumNansReplaced\n') 

6513 for i in range(len(avgspectrum)): 

6514 f.write('%d %.1f %.10f %.10f\n' % (i, frequency[i], avgspectrum[i], avgSpectrumNansReplaced[i])) 

6515 casalogPost('Wrote %s' % meanSpectrumFile, debug=True) 

6516 f.close()

6518def findContinuumChannels(spectrum, nBaselineChannels=16, sigmaFindContinuum=3, 

6519 nanmin=None, baselineMode='min', trimChannels='auto', 

6520 narrow='auto', verbose=False, maxTrim=maxTrimDefault, 

6521 maxTrimFraction=1.0, separator=';', peakOverMad=0, fitResult=None, 

6522 maxGroupsForMaxTrimAdjustment=3, lowHighBaselineThreshold=1.5, 

6523 lineSNRThreshold=20, negativeThresholdFactor=1.15, 

6524 dropBaselineChannels=2.0, madRatioUpperLimit=1.5, 

6525 madRatioLowerLimit=1.15, projectCode='', fCCiteration=0, 

6526 signalRatioTier1=0.965, signalRatioTier2=0.94, sigmaFindContinuumMode='auto', 

6527 enableRejectNarrowInnerWindows=True, useUncorrectedMedian=False, 

6528 returnBluePoints=False, removeOutlierBaselineChannels=False, 

6529 amendMaskIterationName='', useBaseline='auto', idxNonZeroMAD=None): 

6530 """ 

6531 This function is called by runFindContinuum. 

6532 Trys to find continuum channels in a spectrum, based on a threshold or 

6533 some number of edge channels and their median and standard deviation. 

6534 Inputs: 

6535 spectrum: a one-dimensional array of intensity values 

6536 nBaselineChannels: number of channels over which to compute standard deviation/MAD 

6537 sigmaFindContinuum: value to multiply the standard deviation by then add  

6538 to median to get threshold. Default = 3.  

6539 narrow: the minimum number of channels in a contiguous block to accept  

6540 if 0<narrow<1, then it is interpreted as the fraction of all 

6541 channels within identified blocks 

6542 nanmin: the value that NaNs were replaced by in previous steps 

6543 baselineMode: 'min' or 'edge', 'edge' will use nBaselineChannels/2 from each edge 

6544 trimChannels: if integer, use that number of channels. If float between 

6545 0 and 1, then use that fraction of channels in each contiguous list 

6546 (rounding up). If 'auto', then use 0.1 but not more than maxTrim channels. 

6547 The 'auto' mode can also cause trimChannels to be set to 13 or 6 in certain 

6548 circumstances (when moderately strong lines are present). 

6549 maxTrim: if trimChannels='auto', this is the max channels to trim per group for TDM spws; it is automatically scaled upward for FDM spws. 

6550 maxTrimFraction: in trimChannels='auto', the max fraction of channels to trim per group 

6551 separator: the character to use to separate groups of channels in the string returned 

6552 negativeThresholdFactor: scale the nominal negative threshold by this factor (to adjust  

6553 sensitivity to absorption features: smaller values=more sensitive) 

6554 dropBaselineChannels: percentage of extreme values to drop in baseline mode 'min' 

6555 madRatioUpperLimit, madRatioLowerLimit: if ratio of MADs (MAD of all baseline channels /  

6556 MAD of baseline channels with extreme channels dropped) is between these values, then 

6557 apply dropBaselineChannels when defining the MAD of the baseline range 

6558 fitResult: coefficients from linear or quadratic fit, only relevant when meanSpectrumMethod is 

6559 not 'mom0mom8jointMask' 

6560 signalRatioTier1: threshold for signalRatio, above which we desensitize the level to 

6561 consider line emission in order to avoid small differences in noise levels from  

6562 affecting the result (e.g. that occur between serial and parallel tclean cubes) 

6563 signalRatio=1 means: no lines seen, while closer to zero: more lines seen 

6564 signalRatioTier2: second threshold for signalRatio, used for FDM spws (nchan>192) and 

6565 for cases of peakOverMad < 5. Should be < signalRatioTier1. 

6566 sigmaFindContinuumMode: if 'auto', then do not desensitize with signalRatioTier1 

6567 removeOutlierBaselineChannels: after dropBaselineChannels, remove >4*scMAD  

6568 outliers; options: 'high', 'low', 'both'/True, or '' which means none/False 

6569 returnBluePoints: if True, then simply set the continuum ranges to the baseline points  

6570 (i.e. the blue points) instead of what the other heuristics might have found 

6571 useBaseline: 'low', 'middle', 'high' or 'auto'; auto tries to automatically pick 'low' for 

6572 spectra that are emission-line dominated, 'high' if absorption line dominated, or 'both' if 

6573 both types of lines are present 

6574 

6575 Returns: 

6576 1 list of channels to use (separated by the specified separator) 

6577 2 list converted to ms channel selection syntax 

6578 3 positive threshold used 

6579 4 median of the baseline-defining channels 

6580 5 number of groups found 

6581 6 correctionFactor used 

6582 7 inferred true median 

6583 8 scaled MAD of the baseline-defining channels 

6584 9 correction factor applied to get the inferred true median 

6585 10 negative threshold used 

6586 11 lineStrength factor 

6587 12 singleChannelPeaksAboveSFC: how many cases where only a single channel exceeds the threshold  

6588 13 allGroupsAboveSFC 

6589 14 spectralDiff (percentage of median) 

6590 15 value of trimChannels parameter 

6591 16 Boolean describing whether the low values were used as the baseline 

6592 17 value of the narrow parameter 

6593 18 tuple containing the channel numbers of the baseline channels, and their respective y-axis values 

6594 19 value of madRatio: MAD/MAD_after_dropping_extreme_channels 

6595 This value will be larger if there are many tall single channel peaks. 

6596 20 number of ranges it dropped (or would have dropped if it was enabled) 

6597 """ 

6598 if (fitResult is not None): 

6599 myx = np.arange(len(spectrum), dtype=np.float64) 

6600 if (len(fitResult) > 2): 

6601 myx -= fitResult[3] 

6602 originalSpectrum = spectrum + (fitResult[0]*myx**2 + fitResult[1]*myx + fitResult[2]) - nanmean(spectrum) 

6603 casalog.post("min/max spectrum = %f, %f" % (np.min(spectrum), np.max(spectrum))) 

6604 casalog.post("min/max originalSpectrum = %f, %f" % (np.min(originalSpectrum), np.max(originalSpectrum))) 

6605 else: 

6606 originalSpectrum = spectrum + fitResult[0]*myx 

6607 else: 

6608 originalSpectrum = spectrum 

6609 if (narrow == 'auto'): 

6610 narrow = pickNarrow(len(spectrum)) 

6611 autoNarrow = True 

6612 else: 

6613 autoNarrow = False 

6614 npts = len(spectrum) 

6615 percentile = 100.0*nBaselineChannels/npts 

6616 correctionFactor = sigmaCorrectionFactor(baselineMode, npts, percentile) 

6617 sigmaEffective = sigmaFindContinuum*correctionFactor 

6618 if (fitResult is not None): 

6619 if (len(fitResult) > 2): 

6620 casalogPost("****** starting findContinuumChannels (%d) (polynomial=%g*(x-%.2f)**2+%g*(x-%.2f)+%g) ***********" % (fCCiteration, fitResult[0], fitResult[3], fitResult[1], fitResult[3], fitResult[2])) 

6621 else: 

6622 casalogPost("****** starting findContinuumChannels (%d) (slope=%g) ***********" % (fCCiteration, fitResult[0])) 

6623 else: 

6624 casalogPost("****** starting findContinuumChannels (%d) with nBaselineChannels=%d ***********" % (fCCiteration,nBaselineChannels)) 

6625 casalogPost("Using sigmaFindContinuum=%.2f, sigmaEffective=%.1f, percentile=%.0f for mode=%s, channels=%d/%d" % (sigmaFindContinuum, sigmaEffective, percentile, baselineMode, nBaselineChannels, len(spectrum))) 

6626 if (baselineMode == 'edge'): 

6627 # pick n channels on both edges 

6628 lowerChannels = spectrum[:nBaselineChannels/2] 

6629 upperChannels = spectrum[-nBaselineChannels/2:] 

6630 intensityAllBaselineChannels = list(lowerChannels) + list(upperChannels) 

6631 allBaselineXChannels = list(range(0, nBaselineChannels/2)) + \ 

6632 list(range(len(spectrum) - nBaselineChannels/2, len(spectrum))) 

6633 if (np.std(lowerChannels) == 0): 

6634 mad = MAD(upperChannels) 

6635 median = nanmedian(upperChannels) 

6636 casalogPost("edge method: Dropping lower channels from median and std calculations") 

6637 elif (np.std(upperChannels) == 0): 

6638 mad = MAD(lowerChannels) 

6639 median = nanmedian(lowerChannels) 

6640 casalogPost("edge method: Dropping upper channels from median and std calculations") 

6641 else: 

6642 mad = MAD(intensityAllBaselineChannels) 

6643 median = nanmedian(intensityAllBaselineChannels) 

6644 useLowBaseline = True 

6645 else: 

6646 # Pick the n channels with the n lowest values (or highest if those  

6647 # have smallest MAD), but ignore edge channels inward for as long they  

6648 # are identical to themselves (i.e. avoid the 

6649 # effect of TDM edge flagging.) 

6650 myspectrum = spectrum 

6651 allBaselineXChannels = np.array(range(len(myspectrum))) 

6652 # the following could also be len(spectrum), since their lengths are identical 

6653 if (len(originalSpectrum) > 10): # and len(originalSpectrum) <= 128): 

6654 # Was opened up to all data (not just TDM) in Cycle 6 

6655 # picks up some continuum in self-absorbed area in Cha-MMs1_CS in 200-channel spw 

6656 if False: 

6657 # ALMA Cycle 4+5 

6658 idx = np.where((originalSpectrum != originalSpectrum[0]) * (originalSpectrum != originalSpectrum[-1])) 

6659 else: 

6660 # ALMA Cycle 6 onward 

6661 edgeValuedChannels = np.where((originalSpectrum == originalSpectrum[0]) | (originalSpectrum == originalSpectrum[-1]))[0] 

6662 edgeValuedChannelsLists = splitListIntoContiguousLists(edgeValuedChannels) 

6663# casalogPost("edgeValuedChannelsLists: %s" % (edgeValuedChannelsLists)) 

6664 idx = np.array(range(edgeValuedChannelsLists[0][-1] + 1, edgeValuedChannelsLists[-1][0])) 

6665 if len(idx) > 0: 

6666 allBaselineXChannels = idx 

6667 myspectrum = spectrum[idx] 

6668 casalogPost('Avoided %d edge channels of %d when computing min channels. nBaselineChannels is now %d' % (len(spectrum)-len(myspectrum), len(spectrum), nBaselineChannels),debug=True) 

6669 if len(spectrum)-len(myspectrum) > 0: 

6670 casalogPost("using channels %d-%d" % (idx[0],idx[-1]),debug=True) 

6671 else: 

6672 casalogPost('************************* len(idx) == 0') 

6673 

6674 allBaselineXChannelsOriginal = allBaselineXChannels 

6675 

6676 # Sort by intensity: myspectrum is often only a subset of spectrum, so 

6677 # the channel numbers in original spectrum must be tracked separately 

6678 # in the variable: allBaselineXChannels 

6679 idx = np.argsort(myspectrum) 

6680 if idxNonZeroMAD is not None: 

6681 casalogPost('Invoked fix for PIPE-3107: based on earlier iteration (usefulChannels=%d)' % (len(idxNonZeroMAD))) 

6682 idx = idx[np.isin(idx, idxNonZeroMAD)] # preserve the order 

6683 

6684 intensityAllBaselineChannels = myspectrum[idx[:nBaselineChannels]] 

6685 allBaselineOriginalChannels = originalSpectrum[idx[:nBaselineChannels]] # pick the lowest nBaseline channels 

6686 highestChannels = myspectrum[idx[-nBaselineChannels:]]

6688 mad0 = MAD(intensityAllBaselineChannels) 

6689 mad1 = MAD(highestChannels) 

6690 middleChannels = myspectrum[idx[nBaselineChannels:-nBaselineChannels]] 

6691 madMiddleChannels = MAD(middleChannels)

6693 if useBaseline == 'auto' and amendMaskIterationName.find('xtra') < 0 and amendMaskIterationName.find('autoLower') < 0: # to not conflict with 46 lines down 

6694 # Introduced the lowHighBaselineThreshold factor on Aug 31, 2016 for CAS-8938 

6695 whichBaseline = np.argmin([mad0, lowHighBaselineThreshold*mad1, lowHighBaselineThreshold*madMiddleChannels]) 

6696 if whichBaseline == 0 and mad0 <= 0.0: 

6697 # fix for PIPE-3107 

6698 idxNonZeroMAD = np.where(myspectrum != 0.0) 

6699 casalogPost('Invoked fix for PIPE-3107: when MAD=0, ignore those (%d) zero-level channels thereafter: %s' % (len(idxNonZeroMAD[0]),idxNonZeroMAD)) 

6700 idx = idx[np.isin(idx, idxNonZeroMAD)] # preserve the order of idx (np.intersect1d does an internal sort)

6704 medianOfAllChannels = nanmedian(myspectrum[idx]) 

6705 mad0 = MAD(intensityAllBaselineChannels) 

6706 mad1 = MAD(highestChannels) 

6707 middleChannels = myspectrum[idx[nBaselineChannels:-nBaselineChannels]] 

6708 madMiddleChannels = MAD(middleChannels)

6735 allBaselineXChannels = allBaselineXChannels[::-1] # reversed it so that first channel is highest value

6743 intensityAllBaselineChannels = middleChannels 

6744 allBaselineXChannels = allBaselineXChannels[idx][nBaselineChannels:-nBaselineChannels] 

6745 dropBaselineChannels = 0 

6746 mad0 = MAD(intensityAllBaselineChannels)

6748 useMiddleChannels = True 

6749 else:

6761 useLowBaseline = False

6791 allBaselineXChannels = allBaselineXChannelsDropExtremeChannels

6795 

6796 

6797 casalogPost("min method: computing MAD and median of %d channels used as the baseline" % (len(intensityAllBaselineChannels)))

6801

6825 

6826 if removeOutlierBaselineChannels in ['low', 'high', 'both', True]: 

6827 # Try this for PL2023 

6828 rOBCsigma = 3 

6829 if removeOutlierBaselineChannels in ['both', True]:

6831 elif removeOutlierBaselineChannels in ['low']:

6852 threshold = sigmaEffective*mad + medianTrue # prevent crash for undefined variable

6854 lineStrengthFactor = 1.0/signalRatio # prevent crash for undefined variable 

6855 singleChannelPeaksAboveSFC = 0 # prevent crash for undefined variable 

6856 allGroupsAboveSFC = 0 # prevent crash for undefined variable 

6857 spectralDiff = 0 # prevent crash for undefined variable 

6858 spectralDiff2 = 0 # prevent crash for undefined variable 

6859 rangesDropped = 0 # prevent crash for undefined variable 

6860 else: # not returning blue points 

6861 if signalRatio >= 0.99 or ((signalRatio > 0.98) and (15 > peakOverMad > 10)): 

6862 # If nearly no lines are found, then look a bit deeper to allow the possibility of signalRatio to drop enough to  

6863 # go below 0.965, and thereby prevent the desensitizing that comes later (see line 2542). 

6864 weakLineFactor = 1.35 #1.39 gives 0.982 on 305 # 1.5 gives 1.0 on 305 

6865 casalogPost("Initial signalRatio: %f, peakOverMad=%f, Re-assessing." % (signalRatio,peakOverMad)) 

6866 signalRatio = (1.0 - 1.0*len(np.where(np.abs(spectrum-median)>(sigmaEffective*mad*weakLineFactor))[0]) / len(spectrum))**2 

6867 maxdiff = np.max(np.abs(spectrum-median)) 

6868 casalogPost("max(abs(spectrum-median)) = %f while sigmaEffective(%f)*mad(%f)*%.2f=%f" % (maxdiff,sigmaEffective,mad,weakLineFactor,sigmaEffective*mad*weakLineFactor)) 

6869 originalMedian = np.median(originalSpectrum) 

6870 # Should not divide by post-baseline-fit median since it may be close to 0 

6871 spectralDiff = 100*np.median(np.abs(np.diff(spectrum)))/originalMedian 

6872 spectralDiff2 = 100*np.median(np.abs(np.diff(spectrum,n=2)))/originalMedian 

6873 casalogPost("signalRatio=%f, spectralDiff = %f and spectralDiff2=%f percent of the median" % (signalRatio, spectralDiff,spectralDiff2)) 

6874 lineStrengthFactor = 1.0/signalRatio 

6875 if (spectralDiff2 < 0.65 and npts > 192 and signalRatio<signalRatioTier2): # used to be <0.95 but regression 321 has 0.949 so use 0.94 

6876 # This appears to be a channel-averaged FDM spectrum with lots of real line emission. 

6877 # So, don't allow the median to be raised, and reduce the mad to lower the threshold. 

6878 # page 15: G11.92_B7.ms_spw3 yields spectralDiff2=0.6027 

6879 # We can also get into here if there is a large slope in the mean spectrum, so we 

6880 # counter that by removing a linear slope before evaluating lineSNR. 

6881 casalogPost('The spectral difference (n=2) is rather small, so set signalRatio=0 to reduce the baseline level.',debug=True) 

6882 signalRatio = 0 

6883 if True: 

6884 # note: this slope removal differs from the one in runFindContinuum because 

6885 # it always acts upon the whole spectrum, not just the potential baseline windows. 

6886 print("Removing linear slope for purposes of computing lineSNR.") 

6887 x = np.arange(len(spectrum)) 

6888 slope, intercept = linfit(x, spectrum, MAD(spectrum)) 

6889 newspectrum = spectrum - x*slope 

6890 newmad = MAD(newspectrum) 

6891 # Avoid high edge channels from creating false high SNR 

6892 lineSNR = (np.max(newspectrum[1:-1])-np.median(newspectrum))/newmad 

6893 else: 

6894 # Avoid high edge channels from creating false high SNR 

6895 lineSNR = (np.max(spectrum[1:-1])-median)/mad 

6896 casalogPost('lineSNR = %f' % lineSNR) 

6897 if (lineSNR > lineSNRThreshold): 

6898 casalogPost('The lineSNR > %d, so scaling the mad by 1/3 to reduce the threshold.' % lineSNRThreshold, debug=True) 

6899 mad *= 0.33 

6900 if (trimChannels == 'auto'): 

6901 trimChannels = 6 

6902 casalogPost('Setting trimChannels to %d.' % (trimChannels)) 

6903 else: 

6904 casalogPost('Not reducing mad by 1/3: npts=%d, signalRatio=%.3f, spectralDiff2=%.2f' % (npts,signalRatio,spectralDiff2),debug=True) 

6905 if useMiddleChannels or useUncorrectedMedian: 

6906 medianTrue = median 

6907 else: 

6908 # Do not use signalRatio here as the 5th parameter anymore, because we may have set it to zero just above,  

6909 # but 1/lineStrengthFactor is the same value as before it was set to zero. Setting it to zero causes 

6910 # problems on non-hot core FDM, like spw29 of 2015.1.00581.S, uid://A001/X2f6/X16b (CAS-11671). Not 

6911 # setting it to zero changes the selection on hot cores, some giving more channels, some giving fewer, 

6912 # but not drastically either direction. Largest change is on spw22 of uid://A001/X2f6/X265 (page 245). 

6913 medianTrue = medianCorrected(baselineMode, percentile, median, mad, 

6914 1.0/lineStrengthFactor, useLowBaseline) 

6915 if medianTrue < np.min(spectrum): 

6916 casalogPost("**** PIPE-525: Corrected median is less than all data points. Using true median instead.") 

6917 medianTrue = np.median(spectrum) 

6918 

6919 peakFeatureSigma = (np.max(spectrum)-medianTrue)/mad 

6920 # De-sensitize the threshold in order to avoid small differences in noise levels  

6921 # (e.g. that occur between serial and parallel tclean cubes) 

6922 # from producing drastically different continuum selections. 

6923 if ((signalRatio > signalRatioTier1) or (signalRatio > signalRatioTier2 and peakOverMad < 5)) and (sigmaFindContinuumMode in ['auto','autolower']): 

6924 casalogPost('findContinuumChannels: desensitizing because %f>%f or (%f>%f and %f<5)' % (signalRatio,signalRatioTier1,signalRatio,signalRatioTier2,peakOverMad)) 

6925 maxPeakFeatureSigma = (np.max(spectrum) - np.min(spectrum))/MAD(spectrum) 

6926 if peakFeatureSigma > maxPeakFeatureSigma: 

6927 oldmad = 1*mad 

6928 mad *= peakFeatureSigma/maxPeakFeatureSigma 

6929 casalogPost('findContinuumChannels: Limiting peakFeatureSigma from %f to %f, reset MAD from %f to %f' % (peakFeatureSigma,maxPeakFeatureSigma,oldmad,mad)) 

6930 peakFeatureSigma = maxPeakFeatureSigma 

6931 else: 

6932 casalogPost('findContinuumChannels: not limiting peakFeatureSigma because %f > %f' % (peakFeatureSigma,maxPeakFeatureSigma)) 

6933 threshold = sigmaEffective*mad + medianTrue 

6934 # Use a (default=15%) lower negative threshold to help prevent false identification of absorption features. 

6935 negativeThreshold = -negativeThresholdFactor*sigmaEffective*mad + medianTrue 

6936 casalogPost("MAD = %f, median = %f, trueMedian=%f, signalRatio=%f" % (mad, median, medianTrue, signalRatio)) 

6937 casalogPost("findContinuumChannels: computed threshold = %f, medianTrue=%f" % (threshold, medianTrue)) 

6938 channels = np.where(spectrum < threshold)[0] 

6939 if (negativeThreshold is not None): 

6940 channels2 = np.where(spectrum > negativeThreshold)[0] 

6941 channels = np.intersect1d(channels,channels2) 

6942 

6943 # for CAS-8059: remove channels that are equal to the minimum if all  

6944 # channels from it toward the nearest edge are also equal to the minimum:  

6945 channels = list(channels) 

6946 if (abs(originalSpectrum[np.min(channels)] - np.min(originalSpectrum)) < abs(1e-10*np.min(originalSpectrum))): 

6947 lastmin = np.min(channels) 

6948 channels.remove(lastmin) 

6949 removed = 1 

6950 casalogPost("Checking channels %d-%d" % (np.min(channels),np.max(channels))) 

6951 for c in range(np.min(channels),np.max(channels)): 

6952 mydiff = abs(originalSpectrum[c] - np.min(originalSpectrum)) 

6953 mycrit = abs(1e-10*np.min(originalSpectrum)) 

6954 if (mydiff > mycrit): 

6955 break 

6956 if c in channels: 

6957 channels.remove(c) 

6958 removed += 1 

6959 casalogPost("Removed %d channels on low channel edge that were at the minimum." % (removed)) 

6960 # Now come in from the upper side 

6961 if (abs(originalSpectrum[np.max(channels)] - np.min(originalSpectrum)) < abs(1e-10*np.min(originalSpectrum))): 

6962 lastmin = np.max(channels) 

6963 channels.remove(lastmin) 

6964 removed = 1 

6965 casalog.post("Checking channels %d-%d" % (np.max(channels),np.min(channels))) 

6966 for c in range(np.max(channels),np.min(channels)-1,-1): 

6967 mydiff = abs(originalSpectrum[c] - np.min(originalSpectrum)) 

6968 mycrit = abs(1e-10*np.min(originalSpectrum)) 

6969 if (mydiff > mycrit): 

6970 break 

6971 if c in channels: 

6972 channels.remove(c) 

6973 removed += 1 

6974 casalogPost("Removed %d channels on high channel edge that were at the minimum." % (removed)) 

6975 peakChannels = np.where(spectrum > threshold)[0] 

6976 peakChannelsLists = splitListIntoContiguousLists(peakChannels) 

6977 widthOfWidestFeature = maxLengthOfLists(peakChannelsLists) 

6978 casalogPost("Width of widest feature = %d (length spectrum = %d)" % (widthOfWidestFeature, len(spectrum))) 

6979 # C4R2 had signalRatio < 0.6 and spectralDiff2 < 1.2 but this yielded only 1 channel  

6980 # of continuum on NGC6334I spw25 when memory expanded to 256GB. 

6981 if (signalRatio > 0 and signalRatio < 0.925 and spectralDiff2 < 1.3 and 

6982 len(spectrum) > 1000 and trimChannels=='auto' and 

6983 widthOfWidestFeature < len(spectrum)/8): 

6984 # This is meant to prevent rich hot cores from returning only 1 

6985 # or 2 channels of continuum. signalRatio>0 is to avoid conflict 

6986 # with the earlier heuristic above where it is set to zero. 

6987 trimChannels = 13 

6988 if autoNarrow: 

6989 narrow = 2 

6990 casalogPost('Setting trimChannels=%d, narrow=%s since many lines appear to be present (signalRatio=%f).' % (trimChannels,str(narrow), signalRatio)) 

6991 else: 

6992 casalogPost('Not changing trimChannels from %s: signalRatio=%f, spectralDiff2=%f' % (str(trimChannels), signalRatio, spectralDiff2)) 

6993 

6994 

6995 peakMultiChannelsLists = splitListIntoContiguousListsAndRejectNarrow(peakChannels, narrow=2) 

6996 allGroupsAboveSFC = len(peakChannelsLists) 

6997 singleChannelPeaksAboveSFC = allGroupsAboveSFC - len(peakMultiChannelsLists) 

6998 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels) 

6999 casalogPost("Found %d potential continuum channels: %s" % (len(channels), str(selection))) 

7000 if (len(channels) == 0): 

7001 selection = '' 

7002 groups = 0 

7003 else: 

7004 channels = splitListIntoContiguousListsAndRejectZeroStd(channels, spectrum, nanmin, verbose=verbose) 

7005 if verbose: 

7006 print("channels = ", channels) 

7007 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels,separator=separator) 

7008 groups = len(selection.split(separator)) 

7009 casalogPost("Found %d channels in %d groups after rejecting zero std: %s" % (len(channels), groups, str(selection))) 

7010 if (len(channels) == 0): 

7011 selection = '' 

7012 else: 

7013 casalogPost("Calling splitListIntoContiguousListsAndTrim(totalChannels=%s, channels=%s, trimChannels=%s, maxTrim=%d, maxTrimFraction=%f)" % (str(npts), str(channels), str(trimChannels), maxTrim, maxTrimFraction)) 

7014 originalChannels = channels[:] 

7015 channels = splitListIntoContiguousListsAndTrim(npts, channels, 

7016 trimChannels, maxTrim, maxTrimFraction, verbose) 

7017 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels) 

7018 if selection == '': # fix for PIPE-359 

7019 maxTrim = 0.1; trimChannels = 2 

7020 casalogPost("All potential continuum channels trimmed, which is quite rare. Reverting to maxTrim=%.2f and trimChannels=%d." % (maxTrim,trimChannels), priority='WARN') 

7021 channels = splitListIntoContiguousListsAndTrim(npts, originalChannels, 

7022 trimChannels, maxTrim, maxTrimFraction, verbose) 

7023 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels) 

7024 if selection == '': 

7025 casalogPost('Selection is still blank, skipping trim, originalChannels=%s, length=%d' %(originalChannels,len(originalChannels) ), priority='WARN') 

7026 channels = originalChannels # add this line to fix PIPE-2374 

7027 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels) 

7028 groups = len(selection.split(separator)) 

7029 if (groups > maxGroupsForMaxTrimAdjustment and trimChannels=='auto' 

7030 and maxTrim>maxTrimDefault): 

7031 maxTrim = maxTrimDefault 

7032 casalogPost("Restoring maxTrim=%d because groups now > %d" % (maxTrim,maxGroupsForMaxTrimAdjustment)) 

7033 if verbose: 

7034 casalogPost("Calling splitListIntoContiguousListsAndTrim(totalChannels=%s, channels=%s, trimChannels=%s, maxTrim=%d, maxTrimFraction=%f)" % (str(npts), str(channels), str(trimChannels), maxTrim, maxTrimFraction)) 

7035 trialChannels = splitListIntoContiguousListsAndTrim(npts, channels, 

7036 trimChannels, maxTrim, maxTrimFraction, verbose) 

7037 if len(trialChannels) == 0: 

7038 casalogPost("Zero channels left after trimming. Reverting to prior selection.") 

7039 else: 

7040 channels = trialChannels 

7041 if verbose: 

7042 print("channels = ", channels) 

7043 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels) 

7044 groups = len(selection.split(separator)) 

7045 

7046 if verbose: 

7047 print("Found %d groups of channels = " % (groups), channels) 

7048 if (groups > 1): 

7049 # if verbose: 

7050 # casalogPost("Calling splitListIntoContiguousListsAndRejectNarrow(channels=%s, narrow=%s)" % (str(channels), str(narrow))) 

7051 # else: 

7052 # casalogPost("Calling splitListIntoContiguousListsAndRejectNarrow(narrow=%s)" % (str(narrow))) 

7053 trialChannels = splitListIntoContiguousListsAndRejectNarrow(channels, narrow) 

7054 if (len(trialChannels) > 0): 

7055 channels = trialChannels 

7056 casalogPost("Found %d channels after trimming %s channels and rejecting narrow groups." % (len(channels),str(trimChannels))) 

7057 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels) 

7058 groups = len(selection.split(separator)) 

7059 else: 

7060 casalogPost("Not rejecting narrow groups since there is only %d group!" % (groups)) 

7061 casalogPost("Found %d continuum channels in %d groups: %s" % (len(channels), groups, selection)) 

7062 potentialChannels, messages, rangesDropped = rejectNarrowInnerWindowsChannels(channels, fCCiteration) 

7063 if enableRejectNarrowInnerWindows: 

7064 channels = potentialChannels 

7065 for message in messages: 

7066 casalogPost(message) 

7067 else: 

7068 if rangesDropped > 0: 

7069 casalogPost("rejectNarrowInnerWindows wanted to remove %d ranges, but it was not enabled" % (rangesDropped)) 

7070 # endif for the else (i.e., end of returnBluePoints==False) 

7071 selection = convertChannelListIntoSelection(channels) 

7072 groups = len(selection.split(separator)) 

7073 casalogPost("Final: found %d continuum channels (sFC=%.2f) in %d groups: %s" % (len(channels), sigmaFindContinuum, groups, selection)) 

7074 return(channels, selection, threshold, median, groups, correctionFactor, 

7075 medianTrue, mad, computeMedianCorrectionFactor(baselineMode, percentile)*signalRatio, 

7076 negativeThreshold, lineStrengthFactor, singleChannelPeaksAboveSFC, 

7077 allGroupsAboveSFC, [spectralDiff, spectralDiff2], trimChannels, 

7078 useLowBaseline, narrow, [allBaselineXChannels,intensityAllBaselineChannels], 

7079 madRatio, useMiddleChannels, signalRatio, rangesDropped, idxNonZeroMAD)
